zh: 我以前常去打羽毛球，但现在不打了。
en: I used to play badminton a lot, but I don’t play anymore.

zh: 我给你买点东西喝吧。
en: Let me get you something to drink.

zh: 这封信一定要用英文写吗？
en: Must this letter be written in English?

zh: 我现在有很多事要做。
en: I have many things to do now.

zh: 他和那件事半点关系也没有。
en: He had nothing to do with the case.

zh: 那组有六个组员。
en: The group is made up of six members.

zh: 少年决定要向她求婚。
en: The young man decided to propose to her.

zh: 英语是很多国家通用的语言。
en: English is spoken in a lot of countries.

zh: 你虽然考试不及格，但也不必自卑。
en: You needn't be ashamed because you failed the exam.

zh: 我们的俱乐部的人数比你们多三倍。
en: Our club has three times as many members as yours.

zh: 房子需要装修一下了。
en: The house requires repairs.

zh: 你应该从比较简单的书开始。
en: Read such books as can be easily understood.

zh: 他向我大发脾气。
en: He entirely lost his temper with me.

zh: 她来到的时候我会通知你。
en: I'll let you know when she arrives.

zh: 听说他又开始找工作了。
en: I hear he's just begun looking for another job.

zh: 说来奇怪，他的预言竟然真的灵验了。
en: Strange to say, his prediction has come true.

zh: 你最好乘出租车去，不然可能会赶不及。
en: You ought to go by taxi, or you might not get there in time.

zh: 请回到你们各自的座位。
en: Go to your respective seats.

zh: 那个目标是无法达成的。
en: That aim is impossible to attain.

zh: 你患了感冒的话，一定要好好休息。
en: If you have a cold, you should get plenty of rest.

zh: 我吃过晚饭后打开电视看了一会儿新闻。
en: I watched the news on TV after supper.

zh: 这个国家的气候很温和。
en: This country has a mild climate.

zh: 火车挤得要命，我们都找不到位子坐。
en: The train was so crowded that none of us could get a seat.

zh: 恐怕你要加班了。
en: I'm afraid you have to work overtime.

zh: 看来你已经决定好了。
en: I see your mind's made up.

zh: 最近几年到新加坡的旅客人数不断增长。
en: The number of visitors to Singapore has increased year by year.

zh: 这药要每三个小时服一次。
en: This medicine should be taken every three hours.

zh: 你竟然做出那样的事来，你还是人吗？
en: It is wicked of you to do such things.

zh: 我学校离我家只是几步路的路程。
en: I live within walking distance of school.

zh: 这件外套是防雨的。
en: This coat is rainproof.

zh: 我看完电视就上床睡觉了。
en: After I watched TV, I went to bed.

zh: 他们用慢动作把那一幕播了出来。
en: They showed the scene in slow motion.

zh: 可以帮忙关上窗子吗？
en: Close the window, will you?

zh: 他写了一本关于中国的书。
en: He wrote a book on China.

zh: 他的方法已经过时了。
en: He's behind the times in his methods.

zh: 我尝试过很多东西，但最后都失败收场。
en: I tried many things but failed after all.

zh: 地板一定要保持干净。
en: The floor must be very clean.

zh: 他大学毕业已经十年了，但还没有学会独立生活。
en: He has lived off his parents for ten years since he graduated from college.

zh: 我被她甜美的声线迷倒了。
en: I was fascinated by her sweet voice.

zh: 请你不要不敲门就进来。
en: Please don't enter the room without knocking.

zh: 你打来的时候我正准备出门。
en: I was about to leave when you telephoned.

zh: 他只不过是个自私自利的人。
en: He is nothing more than an egoist.

zh: 我们绝不会接受这些横蛮无理的要求。
en: We mustn't give way to these impudent demands.

zh: 我对这样的东西半点兴趣也没有。
en: I am not in the least interested in such a thing.

zh: 今天热得狠。
en: It's very hot today.

zh: 现在只看他们会不会帮忙了。
en: It all depends on whether they will support us.

zh: 小猫一动也不动。
en: The cat didn't move a muscle.

zh: 才不呢，我想他那样做只不过是想哄老婆高兴。
en: No, I think he just does those things because he wants to please his wife.

zh: 他两个姐妹都很漂亮。
en: Both his sisters are beautiful.

zh: 他一生中经历过很多东西。
en: He had various experiences in his life.

zh: 你竟敢这样和我说话？
en: How dare you speak like that to me?

zh: 她拒绝了他的求婚。
en: She turned down his proposal.

zh: 科技的进步为我们的生活带来了巨大的转变。
en: The progress of science has brought about great change in our lives.

zh: 经济繁荣稳定，是每个政府都想达到的目标。
en: A stable economy is the aim of every government.

zh: 看来传闻是真的了。
en: I think the rumor is true.

zh: 昨天我写信写到很晚才去睡觉。
en: Last night I went to bed late after writing a letter.

zh: 你要先输入好个人资料，然后才能买票。
en: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.

zh: 女性通常比男性长寿。
en: Women usually live longer than men.

zh: 我需要几个衣架。
en: I require a few clothes hangers.

zh: 打消这种幼稚的念头吧。
en: Get rid of those kinds of naive ideas.

zh: 详细叙述一下这起事故吧。
en: Describe that accident in detail.

zh: 我觉得这个测试很难。
en: I found the test difficult.

zh: 我们已经做好了最坏的准备。
en: We're prepared for the worst.

zh: 哎哟，撞到你了，对不起！
en: Ah, I hit you, sorry!

zh: 没关系，送你到电梯口。
en: No worries, I will send you to the elevator.

zh: 我来了好长时间了。
en: I've been here for a while.

zh: 你会说上海话吗？
en: Can you speak Shanghainese?

zh: 能听懂一点儿，但是不会讲。
en: I understand it a little, but I can't speak it.

zh: 以前的人以为地球是平的。
en: It was believed that the earth was flat.

zh: 我们闲时应该出外晒晒太阳。
en: We should sometimes expose our bodies to the sun.

zh: 他在回家途中出了意外。
en: He had an accident on his way home.

zh: 这把刀不够锋利。
en: This knife won't cut well.

zh: 让她中午过来。
en: Tell her to come at noon.

zh: 他很少和家里人吃饭。
en: He rarely eats with his family.

zh: 不是每个人都是老实的。
en: Not everyone is honest.

zh: 农民在春天播种。
en: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.

zh: 他被那个女人吸引住了。
en: He was attracted to the woman.

zh: 你对政治感兴趣吗？
en: Are you interested in politics?

zh: 我几乎每天都见到那条狗。
en: I see the dog almost every day.

zh: 不下50个乘客死了。
en: No fewer than 50 passengers were killed.

zh: 暴风雨后，大海恢复了平静。
en: After the storm, the sea was quiet again.

zh: 看见你笑，我就会高兴起来。
en: Your smile always makes me happy.

zh: 他的演说感动了在场的每一个人。
en: All the people present were moved by his speech.

zh: 他们四处找来找去，但就是找不到合适的地方。
en: After searching and asking around, they still couldn't find a suitable place.

zh: 不好意思，请问这条路通往地铁站吗？
en: Excuse me, but is this the right way to the subway station?

zh: 只有少数的人能够理解他的说话。
en: Only a few understood what he said.

zh: 人拥有得愈多，贪念就愈大。
en: The more we have, the greater our desire will be.

zh: 她非常喜欢鲜花。
en: She's very fond of flowers.

zh: 你需要区分善与恶。
en: You should distinguish between right and wrong.

zh: 告诉我你为什么要去那儿。
en: Tell me why you want to go there.

zh: 他看上去已经睡着了。
en: He seems to be asleep.

zh: 事实上，价格每个星期都在攀升。
en: As it is, prices are going up every week.

zh: 虽然她有些缺点，但我始终还是爱她。
en: She has faults, but I love her none the less.

zh: 水是由氢和氧组成的。
en: Water consists of hydrogen and oxygen.

zh: 你就算多努力，也不可能在一两个星期内做完。
en: However hard you try, you can't finish it in a week or so.

zh: 我们在森林里开了一条路。
en: We cleared a path through the woods.

zh: 你是怎么称呼你父亲的呢？
en: What do you call your father?

zh: 我在三天之后收到了回复。
en: The reply came after three days.

zh: 如果我有翅膀的话，真想马上飞到你的身边。
en: If I had wings, I would want to fly to your side right away.

zh: 一天一苹果，医生远离我。
en: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.

zh: 他在枪每时每刻有子弹。
en: He keeps this gun loaded.

zh: 你想好放假去哪里玩了没有？
en: Have you made up your mind where to go for the holidays?

zh: 我突然想到他可能是个商业间谍。
en: It occurred to me that he might be an industrial spy.

zh: 岩石经过风化后，形成了各种奇特的形状。
en: The rocks are weathered into fantastic forms.

zh: 你想去美国读书的话，一定要先申请一张学生签证。
en: If you want to study in the United States, you need to get a student visa.

zh: 我老婆常常说我这样做不对、那样做不对。
en: My wife is always finding fault with me.

zh: 他向她求婚，但她却拒绝了。
en: He asked her to marry him, but she refused.

zh: 我赞成你的说法。
en: I think you're right.

zh: 男女搭配，干活不累。
en: When man and woman unite, work is no longer as tiring.

zh: 这是我生命中最美好的一天。
en: Best day of my life.

zh: 谢谢你寄给我的一张漂亮的卡片。
en: Thank you for sending me a nice card.

zh: 谁这么说说得不对。
en: Whoever said so, it is false.

zh: 一分钟有六十秒。
en: A minute has sixty seconds.

zh: 我或者去看电影，或者去看歌剧。
en: I am either going to see a film, or going to see an opera.

zh: 我要么去看电影，要么和朋友聊天。
en: I am either going to watch a movie, or chat with my friends.

zh: 这不是普通话，而是上海话。
en: This isn't Mandarin, it's Shanghainese.

zh: 与其知道你要走，我宁肯你没有回来过。
en: I would rather that you never returned than know that you wanted to leave.

zh: 我得推我的自行车，因为有个轮胎漏气了。
en: I had to push my bicycle because I had a flat tire.

zh: 不光是你，我也有错。
en: We are both to blame.

zh: 树木排出氧气，吸收二氧化碳。
en: Trees give off oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide.

zh: 物理和化学你更喜欢哪个？
en: Which do you like better, physics or chemistry?

zh: 两个男人在街上打架。
en: Two men were fighting on the street.

zh: 企业第一季度收益大幅增长。
en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.

zh: 可以让我骑一会儿这匹马吗？
en: Can I ride this horse for a while?

zh: 此事必有隐情。
en: There must be something at the back of this matter.

zh: 保罗的成功是一个神话。
en: Paul's success was a myth.

zh: 丈夫去世时她十分绝望。
en: She was in despair when her husband died.

zh: 天黑之后他从不出门。
en: He never goes out after dark.

zh: 我们沿着湖岸散步。
en: We walk along the lakeside.

zh: 我是一个大学生。
en: I'm at university.

zh: 我们庆祝了他的生日。
en: We celebrated his birthday.

zh: 是的，你需要每天练习。
en: Yes, you need to practice every day.

zh: 他不但会说普通话，而且会说上海话。
en: Not only can he speak Mandarin, but Shanghainese as well.

zh: 你不但不和我一起吃饭，反而去和另一个女生吃饭！
en: Not only did you not eat with me, you went to have dinner with another girl!

zh: 你这么漂亮，况且又这么聪明，怎么可能没人追你呢？
en: You're beautiful and intelligent, how is it possible that no man is chasing after you?

zh: 我会告诉她开会的时候说些什么。
en: I will tell her what to say at the meeting.

zh: 由于天气恶劣，飞机延误了。
en: The plane was late due to bad weather.

zh: 我已经找不到回家的路。
en: I already can't find the way home.

zh: 他们往前走而我一直都在往后退。
en: They are going forwards and I am always going backwards.

zh: 虽然我学了两年中文，但是我还是有很多字不认识。
en: Although I have been studying Chinese for 2 years, there are still a lot of words I do not know.

zh: 虽然我很想知道他的名字，只是我的胆子太小了，不敢去问。
en: Even though I really want to know his name, I don't have enough courage, and I'm afraid to go ask.

zh: 只要你好好学中文，你就能去中国读书了。
en: If you learn Chinese well, you can go study in China.

zh: 即使没有人陪我，我也要去看这部电影。
en: Even if no one goes with me, I still want to see this movie.

zh: 就是没有人陪我，我也要去看这部电影。
en: Even if no one goes with me, I still want to see this movie.

zh: 哪怕没有人陪我，我也要去看这部电影。
en: Even if no one goes with me, I still want to see this movie.

zh: 纵然没有人陪我，我也要去看这部电影。
en: Even if no one goes with me, I still want to see this movie.

zh: 这只鸟不能飞。
en: This bird can't fly.

zh: 我有一只狗和两只猫。
en: I have a dog and two cats.

zh: 刚才桌子上有一本书吗？
en: Was there a book on the desk a moment ago?

zh: 大家都认识他的名字。
en: Everybody knows his name.

zh: 我会在七月一号开始上班。
en: I will start working on July first.

zh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。
en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

zh: 他反复读了好几遍她寄来的信，还是没明白她的意思。
en: Over and over again, he read the letter she had mailed him, but he still did not understand it.

zh: 由于这几天下了很多雪，因此学校停课了。
en: Due to the large amounts of snow over the last few days, school has been cancelled.

zh: 我想去外国。
en: I want to go abroad.

zh: 我做的每件事都要通过他的允许。
en: Everything I do requires his permission.

zh: 今天早上我因为太懒而没有出门。
en: This morning, I was very lazy and didn't go out.

zh: 我回去很遥远的地方，不要问我那里。
en: I'm going back to a place that is far away, don't ask me where.

zh: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。
en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.

zh: 有一位奶奶带着小孙子上学。
en: A grandmother is sending her grandson to school.

zh: 我比你小四个月。
en: I am four months younger than you.

zh: 你的生日是几月几号？
en: When is your birthday?

zh: 小王，你是哪年生的？
en: Wang, what year were you born?

zh: 我在两个半小时以前就吃了午饭。
en: I ate lunch two and a half hours ago.

zh: 还有五分钟就到十点了。
en: It's five minutes to ten.

zh: 今天很抱歉，让你等了这么多时间。
en: I'm sorry I made you wait for so long today.

zh: 为了养足精神，你应该早点去睡觉。
en: You should go to sleep early, for restfulness sake.

zh: 我从来没见过这么漂亮的景色。
en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sight.

zh: 机器结构很复杂，我们找来找去也找不到故障的原因。
en: The machine was too complicated for us to find out the cause of the trouble.

zh: 还有很多东西要做。
en: There's still much to do.

zh: 久了不见，便会逐渐淡忘。分开以后，也就自然不会再联络了。
en: Out of sight out of mind. When you're separated you lose touch.

zh: 这首诗本来是用法文写的。
en: This poem was originally written in French.

zh: 这本侦探小说我才看到一半。
en: I'm halfway through this detective story.

zh: 今天是七月二十五号。
en: Today is the 25th July.

zh: 你回家乡去住多少天？
en: How many days are you going to be visiting your hometown?

zh: 昨天下了一天的雨。
en: Yesterday it rained all day.

zh: 今天早上天气多云。
en: This morning the weather is cloudy.

zh: 我已经来了两个小时。
en: I've already been here two hours.

zh: 很多人觉得有教才有学，但其实这个观念是错的。
en: One of the great superstitions about education is that learning is the result of teaching.

zh: 听说不交水费就会被停水，是真的吗？
en: I've heard that if you default on the water rates your water supply will be suspended, is that true?

zh: 车胎被钉子刺穿了。
en: A nail penetrated the car tyre.

zh: 我不知道这本书的作者是谁，但他肯定是个天才。
en: No matter who it was that wrote this book, he's very clever.

zh: 和别人握手的时候，一定要有眼神接触。
en: When you shake hands with somebody, you must look him in the eye.

zh: 因为你不够努力，所以才会失败。
en: The reason why you failed is you didn't try hard enough.

zh: 那条裙子看起来很昂贵。
en: That dress seems to be very expensive.

zh: 一旦养成了坏习惯，就很难改回来了。
en: A bad habit, once formed, is difficult to get rid of.

zh: 请你把你的真实体验写下来。
en: Please write about your real experience.

zh: 如果大家都懂得关心环境的话，就不会有噪音污染了。
en: Noise pollution could be avoided if only people were more sensitive to the environment.

zh: 你明天不去钓鱼的话，我也不去了。
en: If you do not go fishing tomorrow, I will not either.

zh: 我的喉咙好像被火烧一样。
en: My throat burns.

zh: 我觉得这部电影值得一看再看。
en: I think it is worthwhile to see this film twice.

zh: 二十年是一段漫长的岁月。
en: Twenty years is a long time.

zh: 我今天不用当值，不如一起去海滩玩吧。
en: As I am off duty today, let's go to the beach.

zh: 结冰的道路在阳光下闪闪发亮。
en: The icy road sparkled in the sunlight.

zh: 这个会议很重要的，你不要不来。
en: This is a very important meeting. You ought not to miss it.

zh: 我一收到钱就马上还钱给你。
en: As soon as I get paid I will pay you back.

zh: 可以举几个例子吗？
en: Please give us some examples.

zh: 今年夏天你打算去哪里玩啊？
en: Where do you want to go this summer?

zh: 他的演说赢得了观众热烈的掌声。
en: The audience clapped loudly after his speech.

zh: 责任应该由你来负。
en: It is you that are to blame for it.

zh: 别太操心了，不然会掉头发的。
en: Don't worry too much, or you'll go bald.

zh: 我们的结论就是，那个传言是真的。
en: We've come to the conclusion that this is a true story.

zh: 你别⋯⋯别这样和我说话。
en: You don't... you don't talk to me like that.

zh: 我昨天晚上到了这儿。
en: I arrived here last night.

zh: 愿力量与你同在。
en: May the force be with you.

zh: 这间房子要维修了。
en: This house must be done up.

zh: 你可以看，可以听，但手脚不要乱动。
en: Hear and see and be still.

zh: 不论白猫黑猫，抓到老鼠就是好猫！
en: Be it black or white, a cat that catches mice is a good cat!

zh: 他对日文只是略懂皮毛。
en: He has only a superficial knowledge of Japanese.

zh: 我真是哭笑不得了。
en: I don't know whether to cry or to laugh.

zh: 你要为自己做过的事情负责。
en: You should be responsible for your actions.

zh: 这件外套没有口袋。
en: This coat doesn't have pockets.

zh: 不好意思，你可以再说一次吗？
en: I'm sorry, could you repeat that please?

zh: 有人在这张沙发上睡过。
en: Somebody has been sleeping on this sofa.

zh: 他在意外发生的三个小时后恢复意识。
en: He regained consciousness three hours after the accident.

zh: 事情已经发生了，现在怪他也没有用。
en: It is no use blaming him for the accident now.

zh: 对了，可以把你的地址告诉我吗？
en: By the way, what is your address?

zh: 这些古老习俗都是一代一代相传下来的。
en: These old customs have been handed down from generation to generation.

zh: 我做不惯粗重活。
en: I'm not used to hard work.

zh: 北京是中国的首都。
en: Beijing is the capital of China.

zh: 不是的，他是我们的业务主管。
en: No, he's our business manager.

zh: 对，是我们经理。
en: Yes, he's our manager.

zh: 他们不是公司员工吗？
en: Are they not company employees?

zh: 上海夏天的最高温度要到三十八九度，真快热死了！
en: Shanghai summers can reach temperatures of up to 38-9 degrees. That is extremely hot!

zh: 为什么这两天一天比一天热？
en: Why has it been getting hotter and hotter these last two days?

zh: 鹅是一种水鸟。
en: The goose is a waterfowl.

zh: 我用丝线缝了这条裙子。
en: I sewed the dress with silk thread.

zh: 我觉得看电视是浪费时间。
en: I think watching TV is a waste of time.

zh: 把瓜切成六等分。
en: Cut the melon into six equal pieces.

zh: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。
en: We must avoid war at all cost.

zh: 他在演奏会前练了很多次这首曲子。
en: He practiced the piece many times before the concert.

zh: 他从头到脚都湿了。
en: He was wet all over.

zh: 这台机器是花了不少时间和金钱才建成的。
en: It took a lot of time and money to build the machine.

zh: 最近的天气愈来愈凉爽了。
en: It is getting cooler and cooler.

zh: 我们被一大群蜜蜂攻击。
en: We were attacked by swarms of bees.

zh: 天色很暗，但我们还是找到路回家。
en: Dark as it was, we managed to find our way home.

zh: 我想快要下雨了。
en: I think it's going to rain.

zh: 酒是灌入瓶中的诗。
en: Wine is bottled poetry.

zh: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。
en: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.

zh: 我们之间完了，把戒指还给我！
en: It's over between us. Give me back my ring!

zh: 我今天早上看了电视。
en: I watched TV this morning.

zh: 我丢了我的灵感。
en: I lost my inspiration.

zh: 这种科技的优势是什么？
en: What is the advantage of this technology?

zh: 我更喜欢寻求问题的解决方法，而不仅仅是揭露它们。
en: I prefer to look for a solution to problems, not only to report them.

zh: 时间很快地过去了。
en: Time has passed very fast.

zh: 我既没时间购物，又没时间跟我妈妈说再见。
en: I had neither the time to go shopping, nor to say goodbye to my mother.

zh: 你们为什么想今天走？
en: Why do you want to leave today?

zh: 我们走的时候下着雨，到的时候有太阳。
en: It was raining when we left; it was sunny when we arrived.

zh: 在十字路口右转。
en: Turn right at the crossroad.

zh: 博览会将举行六个月。
en: The exposition will be held for six months.

zh: 我真后悔以前没有好好对她。
en: I wish I had treated the girl more kindly.

zh: 他妈的，哪个傻子敢在半夜打我电话?!
en: Fucking hell, what idiot dare phone me in the middle of the night?

zh: 大标题今天早上吸引了我的注意。
en: The headline caught my eye this morning.

zh: 他写文章写得很主观。
en: His writing is very subjective.

zh: 面包是用面粉和水做的，有时还会加入发酵粉。
en: Bread is made from flour, water, and often yeast.

zh: 我突然想起钱包好像放在家中，忘了带了。
en: It occurred to me that I had left my purse at home.

zh: 在小学的时候，她常常被老师骂。
en: When she was in elementary school, the teacher often scolded her.

zh: 长大后你就会开始懂得这段话。
en: You'll start to understand what these words mean when you grow up.

zh: 我在花园里种了些玫瑰。
en: I planted roses in the garden.

zh: 你不应该在背后说别人的坏话。
en: Don't speak ill of others behind their back.

zh: 我病了，所以没有上学。
en: As I was ill, I didn't go to school.

zh: 这是一个产苹果的地区。
en: Apples are produced in this district.

zh: 我很抱歉给你惹来所有的这些麻烦。
en: I'm sorry to cause you all this trouble.

zh: 是时候喂羊了。
en: It's time to feed the sheep.

zh: 你能多烧一点这个肉吗?
en: Could you cook this meat a little more?

zh: 我对亚洲的历史很感兴趣。
en: I'm interested in Asian history.

zh: 除了我，每个人都受到了邀请。
en: Everyone except me was invited.

zh: 我跟你说过的那个女生住在这儿。
en: The girl about whom I told you lives here.

zh: 这部电梯一次能运送10个人。
en: This elevator is capable of carrying 10 persons at a time.

zh: 你知道这儿附近有什么好餐馆吗?
en: Do you know of any good restaurant near here?

zh: 你能教我飞吗?
en: Can you teach me how to fly?

zh: 他认识市长。
en: He knows the mayor.

zh: 你喜欢日本菜吗？
en: Do you like Japanese food?

zh: 由于种种原因，他们在法国的假期没让他们感到满意。
en: For one reason or another their holiday in France didn't come up to expectations.

zh: 因为他的病，他没能来。
en: He can't come because he's ill.

zh: 他这个人话不多，但总是遵守诺言。
en: He is a man of few words, but he always keeps his promise.

zh: 我知道他叫什么名字。
en: I know what his name is.

zh: 我恐怕您打错电话了。
en: I'm afraid you have the wrong number.

zh: 请你给我指点一下。
en: Can you show me the way please?

zh: 在第二排房子的第三家。
en: It's at the third home in the second row of houses.

zh: 往北拐弯走到第二条弄堂就是。
en: Turn north, walk to the second alley, and you're there.

zh: 你一路往前走，过了红绿灯就到了。
en: Go straight down the road, and when you pass the traffic light you're there.

zh: 那么去人民公园怎么走？
en: So which way is it to the People's Park?

zh: 你从这里过去到那里，穿过第二条横马路就是。
en: You can get there by crossing the street at the second intersection.

zh: 从这儿到那儿是很近的。
en: It's not far from here to there.

zh: 你到这儿拐弯角上去坐地铁。
en: Turn here to get on the subway.

zh: 月球表面没有空气，所以没有风，也没有声音。
en: Without air there can be no wind or sound on the moon.

zh: 刚从天上降下来的雪，铺满了整个山头，看起来美丽极了。
en: The fresh snow looks beautiful on the hill.

zh: 我们每天都学习英文。
en: We study English every day.

zh: 那路当然挺远的，我们打的去算了。
en: That way is very far, so we took a taxi.

zh: 请问新桥饭店离这儿远不远？
en: Excuse me, is Xinqiao Restaurant far from here?

zh: 一直向前走对吧？
en: Walk straight, right?

zh: 在哪儿我能找到牙膏？
en: Where can I find toothpaste?

zh: 不能根据服装来判断一个人。
en: You can't judge a person based on clothing.

zh: 我从你的表情猜到你有好消息。
en: I perceive by your face that you have good news.

zh: 谁组织了这次会议？
en: Who organized that meeting?

zh: 那部电影真的很感人。
en: That movie was really moving.

zh: 我弄断了我吉他的一根弦。
en: I broke a string on my guitar.

zh: 没有你的话，我的生命就毁灭了。
en: Life's a ruin without you.

zh: 有借有还，再借不难。有借不还，再借就难。
en: Borrow and return, then you can borrow again. Borrow and don't return, and then the borrowing gets difficult.

zh: 雨，雨，快点消失吧。
en: Rain, rain go away!

zh: 拜托您，请给我一张签证。
en: I beg you, give me a visa.

zh: 客观的历史存在吗？
en: Does objective history exist?

zh: 那人很会讨好老板。
en: That man knows how to get on the president's good side.

zh: 预防胜于治疗。
en: Prevention is better than cure.

zh: 目前我的邮件有点问题。
en: I'm having problems with e-mail right now.

zh: 他说：“我五天前见过她。”
en: "I saw her five days ago," he said.

zh: 不要因为他犯了一个错误就嘲笑他。
en: Don't laugh at him for making a mistake.

zh: 我的一些朋友英语说得很好。
en: Some of my friends can speak English well.

zh: 他会是一个好丈夫。
en: He'll be a good husband.

zh: 她紧紧抓住了我的手。
en: She held on to my hand tightly.

zh: 我做完功课，想去睡觉，可是又要上学⋯⋯
en: Now that I have finished this assignment I want to go to sleep, but I have to go to school.

zh: 房间里面的家具都很残旧了。
en: All the furniture in the room was all worn out.

zh: 我还是单身。
en: I'm still single.

zh: 我们之间已经没有感情了。
en: I don't like him any more than he likes me.

zh: 这个问题暂时放在一边。
en: That problem has been shelved for the time being.

zh: 委员会是由科学家和工程师组成的。
en: The committee consists of scientists and engineers.

zh: 你固然是错了，但也不能怪你。
en: On the one hand, you are wrong, but on the other hand, I can't blame you for that.

zh: 我们还是不要再见面了。
en: It would be better for both of us not to see each other anymore.

zh: 你不要着急。
en: Don't worry.

zh: 万一我来晚的话，就别等我了。
en: Should I be late, don't wait for me.

zh: 请你八点叫我起床。
en: Get me up at eight.

zh: 中国比日本大得多。
en: China is much larger than Japan.

zh: 麻烦你把音量调低一点。
en: Turn down the volume, please.

zh: 我正在去第四医院的路上。
en: I'm going to the Number Four hospital.

zh: 发展经济和保护环境哪一个更重要?
en: Which is more important, economic development or environmental protection?

zh: 你还是去看病吧。
en: You'd better see a doctor.

zh: 没有空气和水，人类就无法生存。
en: Both air and water are indispensable for life.

zh: 我说话的时候请你不要插嘴。
en: Please don't interrupt me while I'm talking.

zh: 我爸爸不是每天都走路上班的。
en: My father does not always walk to work.

zh: 我们明天一大早出发。
en: We're leaving early tomorrow morning.

zh: 我很累，我想我要去睡觉了。
en: I'm tired; I think I'm going to go to bed.

zh: 我经常忘记别人的名字。
en: I always have trouble remembering names.

zh: 请把您的护照给我看一下。
en: Show me your passport, please.

zh: 你等一会然后再给我打电话，可以吗？
en: Could you call me back later?

zh: 去度假的时候我要租辆车。
en: When I go on vacation, I'll rent a car.

zh: 更棒的是房子还有一个漂亮的花园。
en: What is still better is that the house has a beautiful garden.

zh: 可以把收音机的音量调低一点吗？
en: Could you turn down the radio?

zh: 演员们一边唱，一边跳，表演得好极了。
en: With both song and dance, the performers put on an excellent show.

zh: 虽然他考得很好，他口语的汉语不见得比你的好。
en: Although he did well in the exam, his spoken Chinese is not necessarily as good as yours.

zh: 我们匆忙地去火车站了。
en: We hurried to the train station.

zh: 可惜，我们来到的时候，火车已经十五分钟以前走了。
en: Unfortunately, by the time we got there the train had been gone for fifteen minutes.

zh: 我们昨天试了一下，果然是很好。
en: We tried it out yesterday; as expected, it was really good.

zh: 过去两天我觉得不太舒服。
en: I've been feeling poorly for the last couple of days.

zh: 除了鼻子不通以外，我还发着高烧。
en: In addition to a blocked nose, I'm also suffering from a high temperature.

zh: 你到了该去理发的时候了。
en: It is time you had a haircut!

zh: 她突然出名了。
en: She suddenly became famous.

zh: 她花很多钱在买鞋上。
en: She spends a lot of money on shoes.

zh: 她该接受她的命运。
en: She had to accept her fate.

zh: 他超速驾驶，被警察逮捕了。
en: The policeman arrested him for speeding.

zh: 一滴滴水能聚成湖泊。
en: Drop by drop, the water can conglomerate into a lake.

zh: 直子是个游泳员。
en: Naoko is a swimmer.

zh: 手脏的时候千万不要揉眼睛。
en: Never rub your eyes with dirty hands.

zh: 这把伞不是我的，是别人的。
en: This isn't my umbrella; it's somebody else's.

zh: 你还是快点上床睡觉吧，不然感冒会愈来愈严重的。
en: You had better go to bed right away, or your cold will get worse.

zh: 办公室的门是黄色的。
en: The door of the office is yellow.

zh: 可以唱首披头四的歌给我听吗？
en: Will you sing me a Beatles' song?

zh: 过了三天我才知道原来她失踪了。
en: It was not until three days after that I knew she had disappeared.

zh: 不知道他放假的时候可不可以把结他借给我呢？
en: I wonder if he can lend me his guitar during the vacation.

zh: 平等是由宪法保障的。
en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.

zh: 我不喜欢以这种方式被对待。
en: I don't like being treated like this.

zh: 他是我唯一信任的朋友。
en: He's the only friend I trust.

zh: 资本、土地和劳动是生产的三大要素。
en: Capital, land and labor are the three key factors of production.

zh: 如果你离开日本，我会非常想你的。
en: I will badly miss you if you leave Japan.

zh: 他和老婆吵架没问题，但是动手打老婆就不应该了。
en: It's not an issue if he argues with his wife, but he shouldn't hit her.

zh: 有一家便利店在马路斜对面。
en: There's a convenience store diagonally across the street.

zh: 你家里有书吗？
en: Are there books in your house?

zh: 你有没有收据？
en: Have you a receipt?

zh: 他们出发去南极探险。
en: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.

zh: 你怎么定义“幸福”？
en: How would you define "happiness"?

zh: 你去看过医生了吗？
en: Did you go to see a doctor?

zh: 那不是一把刀。这才是一把刀。
en: That's not a knife. THIS is a knife.

zh: 新郎现在在一家公司工作，新娘是我们的老师。
en: The groom works for a company now, and the bride is our teacher.

zh: 听说老师要结婚，大家都想参加她的婚礼。
en: When they heard that their teacher was going to get married, everyone wanted to attend her wedding.

zh: 我们还从来没参加过中国人的婚礼呢。
en: We'd still never been to a Chinese person's wedding.

zh: 我们问老师：“我们可以参加你的婚礼吗？”
en: We asked our teacher: "Can we come to your wedding?"

zh: 客人很多，大部分都是老师的同学和朋友。
en: There were many guests - most of them were our teacher's classmates and friends.

zh: 老师说：“咱们现在就出发。”
en: The teacher said: "Let's set off right now."

zh: 老师和她爱人带着参加婚礼的人来到一个公园。
en: The teacher and her partner took the people attending the wedding to a park.

zh: 这个公园不小，有很多树，还有很多花。
en: This park is pretty big; it has a lot of trees and many flowers.

zh: 十几棵树很快就种好了。
en: About a dozen trees had soon been planted.

zh: 这时候公园里的工人拿来了一些小纸牌。
en: Just then, the workers in the park brought over some small playing cards.

zh: 下面写上我们班同学的名字。
en: Underneath we wrote the names of the students in our class.

zh: 我们来得及。
en: We have enough time.

zh: 他来找我的时候全身都是酒的味道。
en: When he came and found me, his whole body reeked of alcohol.

zh: 他脚受伤了，不能再继续踢足球。
en: He hurt his foot, he can't play soccer anymore.

zh: 有草的地方无水，有水的地方无草。
en: Where there is grass, there is no water. Where there is water, there is no grass.

zh: 希望我的愿望能够实现。
en: I hope I can get my wish fulfilled.

zh: 因为他是个友好的人，所以大家都喜欢他。
en: People like him because he is kind.

zh: 你想怎么做就怎么做。
en: Do as you like.

zh: 这件衬衫我不喜欢。把另外一件给我看一下。
en: I don't like this shirt. Show me another.

zh: 有时我去，有时不去。
en: Sometimes I go, sometimes I don't.

zh: 人生不是凸的。
en: Life is not convex.

zh: 你的眼睛为什么那么大？
en: Why are your eyes so big?

zh: 在你的词典查一查这个词。
en: Look up the word in your dictionary.

zh: 对我来说，质量不如数量。
en: I put quantity after quality.

zh: 你在日本住多久了？
en: How long have you lived in Japan?

zh: 她的英语好极了。
en: Her English is excellent.

zh: 我每六小时量一次体温。
en: I took my temperature every six hours.

zh: “你喜欢蛇吗？”“当然不喜欢。”
en: "Do you like snakes?" "Of course not."

zh: 我需要写一封信。你有纸吗？
en: I have to write a letter. Do you have some paper?

zh: 听众中有学生、老师还有职员，等等。
en: Among the audience, there were students, teachers, clerks, and so on.

zh: 我的血压很低。
en: My blood pressure is low.

zh: 我和往常一样起得很早。
en: I got up early as usual.

zh: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。
en: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.

zh: 我高兴得跳了起来。
en: I jumped for joy.

zh: 我三时左右随便吃了点东西。
en: I had a bite at around 3 o'clock.

zh: 我要一杯冰红茶。
en: I want a cup of iced tea.

zh: 他们两位现在太忙了，不想跟你谈。
en: The two of them are two busy now; they can't talk to you.

zh: 吃点点心你看好吗？
en: Let's eat some dessert, alright?

zh: 我不想买这样的沙发。
en: I don't want to buy this kind of sofa.

zh: 你钱或者信用卡带来没有？
en: Did you bring cash or your credit card with you?

zh: 他把那么难做的活儿丢给我。
en: He foisted a bunch of hard work on me.

zh: 有的人是好的，有的人是坏的。
en: Some people are good, some people are bad.

zh: 把架子上的灰尘擦一下。
en: Dust off the shelf.

zh: 你把衣服晾出来！
en: Hang your clothes out to dry!

zh: 我这个歌唱得好不好？
en: Am I singing that song well?

zh: 西班牙人最爱在晚上外出散散步、乘乘凉。
en: Spaniards love to stroll around in the evening cool.

zh: 那位医生是儿童疾病的专家。
en: The doctor is a great authority on children's diseases.

zh: 请问怎样打电话到日本？
en: How can I make a telephone call to Japan?

zh: 那座大厦天台的景色很美的，想去看看吗？
en: There's a great view from the rooftop of that building. Want to go see?

zh: 超速驾驶是很危险的。
en: Driving too fast is dangerous.

zh: 要是你有空的话，我们就去购物吧。
en: If you have time, let's go shopping.

zh: 我们工作完后就回家了。
en: The work over, we went home.

zh: 社会不是在进步，而是在退步。
en: Social conditions are going backward rather than forward.

zh: 总统不由自主地笑了起来。
en: The president laughed in spite of himself.

zh: 这本书我是买给自己的，不是买给老婆的。
en: I bought this book for myself, not for my wife.

zh: 那位作家用过的家具全都存放在这间博物馆里。
en: The writer's furniture is all shown in this museum.

zh: 我买了一张日报。
en: I bought a Daily News.

zh: 我去和朋友喝了杯啤酒。
en: I went to drink a beer with friends.

zh: 我不想参加典礼。
en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.

zh: 沿着这条大道走，你就会找到电影院了。
en: Go along this street, and you'll find the movie theater.

zh: 我让她等了一分钟。
en: I asked her to wait a minute.

zh: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
en: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.

zh: 他对什么都感好奇。
en: He's curious about everything.

zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。
en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.

zh: 那天我丢了我的照相机。
en: I lost my camera the other day.

zh: 日本人吃很多鱼吗 ?
en: Do Japanese eat a lot of fish?

zh: 我一回到家就打电话给你。
en: I'll ring you as soon as I get home.

zh: 面粉是小麦制成的。
en: Flour is made from wheat.

zh: 您必须排队。
en: You have to queue.

zh: 我上中学的时候有写日记的习惯。
en: I used to keep a diary when I was at high school.

zh: 有人说我和妹妹看起来年纪差不多。
en: People say I look about the same age as my sister.

zh: 她在街上看到我也不跟我打招呼。
en: She ignored me even when she met me on the street.

zh: 他假装听不见老板和他说话。

zh: 天快亮了，我要动身了。
en: It will soon be daybreak and I have to leave.

zh: 时间快要到了，你怎么还拖啊拖的。
en: Time's almost up, why are you still dilly-dallying?

zh: 假如我告诉你，大家不要走来走去，你有意见吗？
en: If I tell you not to run around, would you have any comments?

zh: 今天穿了这件有点儿红的衬衫，我能走出去吗？
en: Can I go out today wearing this shirt that has a little bit of red?

zh: 这种颜色比那种稍微深一点。
en: This color is a bit darker than that one.

zh: 这条领带颜色亮一点，跟这件西装比较配。
en: This tie has a more vibrant color and goes better with this suit.

zh: 先生小姐，你们买点什么首饰？
en: Sir and Miss, what type of jewellery are you looking to buy?

zh: 我觉得价钱太贵，再说没什么特别好看……
en: I think it's too expensive; besides, it doesn't even look that good...

zh: 轻一点还是重一点？
en: Is it a bit lighter or a bit heavier?

zh: 现在正好，不重也不轻。
en: It's good now; neither too heavy nor too light.

zh: 如果小姐要的话，可以打八折。
en: If the lady desires, 20% discount is possible.

zh: 多少钱一斤？
en: How much for half a kilo?

zh: 一斤四元五毛，便宜得不得了！
en: 4.5 yuan for one pound, now isn't that cheap!

zh: 今天我来请客。
en: It's my treat today.

zh: 稍微等一等，马上就好！
en: Wait just a little bit. It'll be done immediately.

zh: 饭勿要盛得满得很。
en: Don't fill up your bowl with too much food.

zh: 你说得我馋死了！
en: The way you describe it makes me drool.

zh: 这片小区的绿地面积有多少？
en: What is the size of this district's greenery area?

zh: 比如说，我要到市中心，有什么车子可以坐吗？
en: For example, if I want to get downtown what bus should I take?

zh: 这儿周围有没有小菜场跟大型超市，买生活用品方便吗？
en: Are there any markets or supermarkets around here? Is it convenient for daily shopping?

zh: 周围环境怎么样？静不静？夜晚闹不闹？
en: How's the neighborhood? Quiet? Noisy at night?

zh: 小区安全吗？夜晚有照明设施吗？
en: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?

zh: 租的房屋要离我工作地方近一点。
en: The rental should be somewhat close to where I work.

zh: 有的，先生你有几位？
en: Yes, there are. How many of you are there, Sir?

zh: 在房间里只能拨市内，长途可以到总台来打。
en: You can only make local calls from the room; you can go to the front desk to call long-distance.

zh: 顺便问一下，餐厅晚上几点钟开始营业？
en: By the way, may I ask when in the evening your restaurant opens?

zh: 先生，请出示护照或者身份证，让我登记一下。
en: Sir, please present your passport or identity card, so I can register it.

zh: 这辆车去静安寺吗？
en: Does this car go to Jingan temple?

zh: 还有两站下去。
en: There are still two stops left.

zh: 对不起，请让我下车。
en: Sorry, please let me off.

zh: 就在这儿停车吧。
en: Stop the car here.

zh: 你吃面条还是吃饭？喝橙汁还是喝咖啡？
en: Do you want to eat noodles or rice? Do you want to drink fruit juice or coffee?

zh: 请问你们几位是美国贸易代表团的吗？
en: Are some of you from the US trade delegation?

zh: 请问最后一次开信箱在什么时间？
en: Excuse me, when was the mailbox last opened?

zh: 要不寄“特快邮件”明天就可以到。
en: How about we use "express mail" so it arrives tomorrow.

zh: 不要把寄件人、收件人地址的姓名填反了！
en: Don't flip-flop the addresses of the sender and recipient!

zh: 身份证你带来吗？
en: Have you brought your ID card with you?

zh: 对不起，没有身份证是不能领汇款的。
en: I'm sorry, without an I.D. you cannot receive a remittance.

zh: 先生，我要存钱，怎么存？
en: Sir, I would like to deposit my money. How do I do that?

zh: 那么硬卡怎么用呢？
en: So, how's the card used?

zh: 请你在这个地方签个字。
en: Please sign here.

zh: 请你帮我换一点零钱行吗？
en: Could you please exchange some small change with me?

zh: 我要打给我女儿一个电话。
en: I'm going to call my daughter.

zh: 你声音大一点，我听不出来！
en: Louder. I can't hear you.

zh: 对不起，你打错电话了。
en: Sorry, you have the wrong number.

zh: 喂，请问现在能给我马上送一叠稿子吗？
en: Hey, could you send over a stack of manuscripts straight away?

zh: 再要开眼界，去看人民广场下面的地下商场。
en: To broaden your view, go see the underground shopping mall beneath People's Square.

zh: 价钱是二十五元五毛。
en: It costs 25 dollars and 50 cents.

zh: 这么贵！能便宜些吗？
en: That's so expensive! Can't you get it cheaper?

zh: 虽然时髦一点，但是价钱太大！
en: It's kind of in vogue, but the price is too much!

zh: 价钱可以打折吗？
en: Can the price be discounted?

zh: 喂，这橘子多少钱买一斤啊？
en: Hey, how much does one pound of these oranges cost?

zh: 行了！就十元买五斤吧。
en: Alright! Ten yuan buys five kilos, OK?

zh: 那么你频道换掉也行啊。
en: You can just switch channels.

zh: 他俩的爱情，已经上升了一个台阶。
en: Their love has gone to the next level.

zh: 我刚知道你在生病，所以下了班来看望你。
en: I just found out that he's sick, so I'll visit him later.

zh: 你到厨房里替我把一把锤子拿来。
en: Could you get a hammer for me from the kitchen please?

zh: 你帮我把这两封信寄掉好吗？
en: Help me send out these two letters, all right?

zh: 一盏电灯不亮了，你帮我来看看好吗？
en: One of the lights is not working. Do you think you could come take a look?

zh: 我谢谢你帮帮忙，给我把灯关了，我想睡觉了。
en: Thank you for helping me. Please turn off the light, I want to go to sleep.

zh: 因为今天明天我休息，所以趁机会快点搬好它。
en: I don't have to go to work today and tomorrow, so I will use the opportunity to quickly finish moving it.

zh: 既然房间里新家具都买好了，这点破家具都可以丢掉了！
en: Now that we've bought new furniture for the room, why not throw away this old, worn-out furniture?

zh: 我家里有个老年人突然倒在地上，大概是中风了。
en: An elderly person in my family suddenly fell to the ground; he likely suffered a stroke.

zh: 请你们快点来一辆救护车，快！
en: Please get here with the ambulance quickly. Hurry up!

zh: 快赶到那边去打听，快走！
en: Nip over there and ask. Hurry!

zh: 痛过，但是没现在这么厉害。
en: It's ached before, but never as badly as right now.

zh: 有点恶心，但是吐不出来。
en: I feel a little nauseous, but I'm unable to throw up.

zh: 这点药一天吃三次。
en: These medicines should be taken three times a day.

zh: 已经退休了，但还常常被他们请去做顾问。
en: He's already retired but is often asked by them to consult.

zh: 我喜欢画油画，但是我不想拿它做我的终身职业。
en: I like to do oil painting, but I don't intend to make that my lifelong occupation.

zh: 今天即使再忙，也要做完这些事情才走。
en: Even though it's busy today, this bit of work must be finished before leaving.

zh: 因为你们公司的业务能够发挥我的特长。
en: Because your business can play to my strengths.

zh: 你认为可以胜任那些方面的工作？
en: Do you think that you are qualified for that aspect of the work?

zh: 你看这张表吧，上面已经写清楚了。
en: Look at this table; it has been written out clearly.

zh: 每月六百元，每周一天休息，行吗？
en: Six hundred dollars a month, with a day rest every week. That works for you?

zh: 不是瞎说，我这份工作真是没劲！
en: Do not talk nonsense, My job is very boring!

zh: 长年累月东奔西走忙死了，生活太没有规律了。
en: I'm so busy running about year in, year out. My life has no consistency.

zh: 实在闲得没事干。
en: I'm bored and I have nothing to do.

zh: 我不喜欢出去玩，常常在家泡壶咖啡，跟朋友下围棋象棋。
en: I don't like going out to have fun. Usually, I make my own coffee at home, and have a game of chess with a friend.

zh: 朋友之间，大家谈谈心，非常爽快。
en: Between friends, to have a heart-to-heart is really rejuvenating.

zh: 你这个人真是傻瓜一个，这么笨！
en: You really are an idiot. You're so stupid!

zh: 如果我有时间有钱，我要到欧洲去旅游。
en: If I have time and enough money, I'd want to go traveling in Europe.

zh: 我这趟旅程一共需要十二天。
en: This trip of mine would need twelve days in total.

zh: 祝你一路上玩得愉快。
en: Have a pleasant trip.

zh: 哦，我才想起来，身份证不要忘了带。
en: Oh, I just remembered, do not forget to bring your ID.

zh: 你安全到达目的地以后，别忘记打个电话告诉我。
en: When you safely arrive at your destination, don't forget to call me.

zh: 我肯定忘了带雨伞，但现在已经太迟了。
en: I must have forgotten my umbrella, but it's too late now.

zh: 火车马上就要开，我们勉强可以赶到。
en: The train is about to leave, we can barely catch it.

zh: 你要交几张照片，填好几张表格，办好签证。
en: You need to hand in a few photos, fill in a form, and get a visa.

zh: 请你把护照出示给我看看，还有入境表格填好了吗？
en: Please let me see your passport, also did you complete the immigration form?

zh: 子女培养全社会都很关心，教育要进行改革。
en: The raising of children is something that concerns the entire community. There will be an education reform.

zh: 开口要有礼貌，不讲下流话。
en: One must be respectful when speaking, and not say obscene things.

zh: 绿灯时，拐弯车要让人。
en: When the light is green, cars turning must yield to pedestrians.

zh: 做个讨人喜欢的小朋友。
en: Be a good boy.

zh: 上海人要树立上海新形象。
en: The Shanghainese people must build up Shanghai's new image.

zh: 本地人、外来人齐心共创上海新文明。
en: Native Chinese people are working alongside foreigners to change the culture of Shanghai.

zh: 咱们吃个西瓜吧！
en: Let's eat a watermelon!

zh: 我好不容易找到了你们的房子。
en: I found your house with difficulty.

zh: 请你事先把计划告诉我。
en: Please let me know the schedule beforehand.

zh: 这几年的天气很反常。
en: We've been having strange weather the past few years.

zh: 他的计划是在那条河上建一座桥。
en: His plan is to build a bridge over that river.

zh: 那两个人偷偷溜进了房子里，给人看见了。
en: The two men were seen to steal into the house.

zh: 我觉得你应该给他写一封感谢信。
en: I suggest that you should write him a thank-you letter.

zh: 我今天想外出，不想留在家中。
en: I feel like going out rather than staying at home today.

zh: 我梦见的是一个没有战争的、和平的世界。
en: The world which I saw in my dream was a peaceful world devoid of war.

zh: 这两个学生都通过了所有的测验。
en: Both those students passed all the tests.

zh: 你出门的时候别忘了带伞。
en: Don't forget to take your umbrella when you leave.

zh: 你在这里签个名就行了。
en: All you have to do is sign your name here.

zh: 我们可以在二月二十八日三时左右见面吗？
en: Can we meet February 28, around 3:00 pm?

zh: 把这些物质混合起来是很危险的。
en: It's dangerous to mix these substances.

zh: 算一算你花了多少钱买书。
en: Try to estimate how much you spent on books.

zh: 台风吹毁了很多房屋。
en: Not a few houses were destroyed by the typhoon.

zh: 你今天下午去图书馆的话，可以顺道替我还两本书吗？
en: If you are going to the library this afternoon, would you please return two books for me whilst you are there?

zh: 我可以和家人一起来吗？
en: May I bring my family along?

zh: 她不想一直胖下去，所以正在戒吃蛋糕。
en: She does not eat cake, so as not to put on any more weight.

zh: 我把他叫做「矮子」，他就气得不得了。
en: He got mad at me for calling him Shorty.

zh: 我们匆匆忙忙的赶到机场，飞机却已经起飞了。
en: We hurried to the airport only to miss the plane.

zh: 如果天气好的话，我打算明天出发。
en: I mean to go tomorrow if the weather is fine.

zh: 我们去市区吃饭，然后再看场电影吧。
en: Let's have lunch downtown and take in a show.

zh: 你现在出门的话，肯定会堵车的。
en: If you leave now, I'm sure you'll be caught in a traffic jam.

zh: 他很有信心赢这场比赛。
en: He is sure of winning the game.

zh: 我真想看看古代的世界是怎样的。
en: I wish I could see the ancient world.

zh: 过了一会，那人就走进了房间。
en: After a while, the man came into the room.

zh: 快点，不然你吃午饭就要迟到了。
en: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late for lunch.

zh: 我花园里的一部分玫瑰是白色的，其他的是红色的。
en: Some of the roses in my garden are white, and the others are red.

zh: 她穿了一件蓝色大衣。
en: She was wearing a blue coat.

zh: 红色和蓝色，你喜欢那一个?
en: Red and blue - which one do you like?

zh: 你知道为什么他们安静下来了呢？
en: Do you know why they stopped talking?

zh: 我通常踏单车上学⋯⋯啊，说错了，应该是上班才对。
en: I usually ride my bike to school. I mean to the office.

zh: 从她的外表上看，我想她大半是个有钱人。
en: Judging from her appearance, I think that she's rich.

zh: 我今天下午不想出外。
en: I don't want to go outside this afternoon.

zh: 请在四月底之前交上你的学期报告。
en: You should turn in your term papers by the end of April.

zh: 虽然他已经用尽全力温习，但测验还是不及格。
en: With all his efforts, he failed the test.

zh: 我觉得自己像是不请自来似的。
en: I felt as if I were an uninvited guest.

zh: 销售率正在急剧下滑。
en: The sales are slipping.

zh: 三十年前的时装款式又流行起来了。
en: Fashions of thirty years ago have come back in style.

zh: 如果世界上没有神，那么我就用双手创造出神。
en: If God doesn't exist in our world, then I will create God with my own hands.

zh: 她只有两岁，但她已经会数到100了。
en: She's only two years old, but she can already count to 100.

zh: 用钢笔写，不要用铅笔写。
en: Write with a pen, not with a pencil.

zh: 夏天我们习惯去河里游泳。
en: In the summer, we're used to going swimming in the river.

zh: 那场演讲很长，但我却听得津津有味。
en: The lecture was very long, but I enjoyed it none the less.

zh: 在这二百年来，有很多人从农村搬到了市区居住。
en: This movement from rural to urban areas has been going on for over two hundred years.

zh: 从山顶上可以欣赏到秀丽的海景。
en: You can get a fine view of the sea from the mountaintop.

zh: 这朵花是黄色的，但是其他全都是蓝色的。
en: This flower is yellow, but all the others are blue.

zh: 你最会操作这台机器了。
en: You understand best how to use the machine.

zh: 先生，请别生我的气！我是新来的工人！
en: Please don't get mad, sir! I'm a new worker!

zh: 人们怎么能在飞机上睡觉？
en: How do people manage to sleep on the plane?

zh: 若有大地震，房屋会倒塌呀！
en: If there's a big earthquake, the house could really collapse!

zh: 它就像我的尾巴一样，我去哪里它就去哪里。
en: It's like my tail; wherever I go, it goes.

zh: 他听到那个好消息，高兴得跳了起来。
en: He could not help jumping for joy at the good news.

zh: 不好意思，现在线路繁忙。
en: Sorry, the line is busy now.

zh: 我下个月要搬家了。
en: I'm moving next month.

zh: 她是一位真正的美人。
en: She's a real beauty.

zh: 一份我们不喜欢的工作就是。。。一份工作。
en: A job that you don't love is... a job.

zh: 千万别相信一个手里拿手枪的女人。
en: Never trust a woman with a pistol in hand.

zh: 我请妈妈四点叫我起床。
en: I asked Mother to wake me up at four.

zh: 这本书会让你发挥想像力。
en: This book will awaken your imagination.

zh: 我相信他是个能干的人。
en: I'm sure he is a man of ability.

zh: 据说他以前是整个村子最有钱的人。
en: He is said to have been the richest man in the village.

zh: 这条裙子挺漂亮的，可以试穿吗？
en: I like this skirt. May I try it on?

zh: 以初学者来说，你打网球已经算是打得不错了。
en: You are a good tennis player, as beginners go.

zh: 他们的生活环境很好。
en: They live in a good environment.

zh: 我是因为太忙，所以才没有回信给你的。
en: I didn't answer your letter, because I was busy.

zh: 学外语要花好几年的时间才能学得精通。
en: It takes years to master a foreign language.

zh: 你的眼睛让我想到了星星。
en: Your eyes remind me of stars.

zh: 丘陵沐浴在阳光下。
en: The hills are bathed in sunlight.

zh: 这些年空气质量恶化了。
en: Air quality has deteriorated these past few years.

zh: 为什么月亮晚上发光？
en: Why does the moon shine at night?

zh: 你想要糖和奶吗？
en: Would you like sugar and milk?

zh: 为什么你买了一本那么贵的词典？
en: Why did you get such a costly dictionary?

zh: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。
en: Once the chemical plant caught fire, it exploded.

zh: 他们的友情深深地感动了我们。
en: Their friendship moved us deeply.

zh: 你的作文非常好，而且错误很少。
en: Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.

zh: 哦，能不能请你帮我听一下电话？
en: Oh, could you please get the phone for me?

zh: 我看见一条脏狗进了花园。
en: I saw a dirty dog enter the garden.

zh: 我看见天上有奇怪的东西。
en: I saw something strange in the sky.

zh: 尽管语言和习俗不同，大家还是能够成为朋友。
en: Despite different languages and cultures, everyone still became friends.

zh: 我该在这个服务器上设置一个防火墙。
en: I need to configure this server with an appropriate firewall system.

zh: 敌人的敌人就是同伴。
en: An enemy of an enemy is a friend.

zh: 您吃不吃辣椒？
en: Do you want pepper on it?

zh: 不好意思，这本书已经卖完了。
en: Sorry, the book is out of stock.

zh: 我一定要在明天前把书还给他。
en: I must give back the book to him by tomorrow.

zh: 他的驾驶技术很差，但也勉强通过了驾驶考试。
en: He managed to pass his driving test even though he was a poor driver.

zh: 这是一把中式扇子。
en: This is a Chinese fan.

zh: 那是学英语最好的方法。
en: That's the best approach to the study of English.

zh: 我听得见你，但我看不见你。
en: I hear you, but I don't see you.

zh: 告诉我你手里有什么。
en: Tell me what you have in hand.

zh: 眼不见，心不烦。
en: Out of sight, out of mind.

zh: 他在工作中经验尚浅。
en: He is still green at the job.

zh: 当我回到家的时候，我妹妹正在弹吉他。
en: When I came home, my sister was playing the guitar.

zh: 每一个孩子都应该享有平等的学习机会。
en: It is essential that every child have the same educational opportunities.

zh: 我种了很多花，有些是红色的，有些是黄色的。
en: I have a lot of flowers. Some are red and some are yellow.

zh: 这家酒店可以容纳一千人。
en: This hotel has accommodations for 1,000 guests.

zh: 他以总统的身份访问了日本。
en: He visited Japan in the character of President.

zh: 我有个黄鱼脑袋。
en: I have a memory like a goldfish.

zh: 为什么不尝尝寿司？
en: Why don't you have some sushi?

zh: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。
en: If necessary, I have no objection to paying a special fee.

zh: 丑闻让他付出了失去声誉的代价。
en: That scandal cost him his reputation.

zh: 我们有一位非常好的厨师。
en: We have a very good chef.

zh: 虽然我住在她家附近，可是也很少见到她。
en: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.

zh: 爱和被爱是人生最大的乐事。
en: To love and to be loved is the greatest happiness.

zh: 你出国看看，才会知道日本是多么的细小。
en: It is not until you go abroad that you realize how small Japan is.

en: He doesn't tan.

en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.

en: With the approach of Christmas, business improved somewhat.

en: Can I borrow your tennis racket today?

en: Should he be given another chance, he would do his best.

en: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.

en: At first glance, the question seemed easy.

en: Start right now, and you'll catch up with them.

en: She's famous as a singer but not as a poet.

en: He took her words as a compliment.

zh: 别和这个人打交道。
en: Don't get involved with that guy.

zh: 明天就要去入学面试了，希望可以通过。
en: I've got my college interview tomorrow. Hopefully I'll pass.

zh: 一年四季，我最喜欢夏天，你呢？
en: There are four seasons in a year, and the one I like most is summer. How about you?

zh: 他一辈子都在和时间赛跑。
en: His life is a neverending race against time.

zh: 你几点下课？
en: What time do you get out of class?

zh: 你几点下班？
en: When are you getting off work?

zh: 亲爱的，记得11点喊我起床工作。
en: Honey, don't forget to wake me up for work at 11 o'clock.

zh: 你的胸很小。
en: You have a small chest.

zh: 没关系，我可以等。
en: No problem, I can wait.

zh: 我做梦也没想到会在这里见到你。
en: I never dreamed of seeing you here.

zh: 你是我最可靠的朋友。
en: You're the most reliable friend I have.

zh: 政府的开支有些过头了。
en: The government's expenditures are a bit excessive.

zh: 那么首先我们应该召开一次家庭会议。
en: In that case we should start by having a family meeting.

zh: 十年来，他靠父亲的救济生存。
en: He's been living off his father's financial support for ten years now.

zh: 这样合法吗？
en: Is this legal?

zh: 你的法语讲的很好。我希望可以讲的像你一样好。
en: You speak French very well. I wish I could speak it as well as you.

zh: 晚上我们去吃饺子，好吗？
en: We're going out for dumplings in the evening, all right?

zh: 快点，菜要凉了！
en: Hurry up! The food will get cold.

zh: 他学着学着就睡着了。
en: While he was studying, he fell asleep.

zh: 药物缓解了他的痛苦。
en: The medicine decreased his pain.

zh: 马上就要入秋了。
en: Autumn is just around the corner.

zh: 我们需要有才华的人。
en: We need talented people.

zh: 她的头发长回原来的长度了。
en: Her hair grew back to its original length.

zh: 她帮他系了领带，因为他不会。
en: She helped him tie his tie because he didn't know how to.

zh: 体育场里有很多兴奋的球迷。
en: There were a lot of excited fans in the stadium.

zh: 你有没有给孤儿献上一首歌呢？
en: Have you ever dedicated a song to the orphans?

zh: 我男朋友是个记者。
en: My boyfriend is a journalist.

zh: 昨天我遇见了世界上最著名的演员之一。
en: Yesterday I met one of the most popular actors in the world.

zh: 如果你们之间有问题，应该当面告诉他，不要在背后说他。
en: If you have a bone to pick with a person, tell it to his face instead of saying things behind his back.

zh: 他认同我的意见。
en: He agreed with me.

zh: 厕所门上的标示显示「使用中」的时候，代表有人正在使用。
en: When the sign on the door of a rest room says OCCUPIED, it means someone is using it.

zh: 他因为生病而放弃了学业。
en: Illness made him give up his studies.

zh: 明天有人要陪我去唱歌吗?
en: Will anyone go singing with me tomorrow?

zh: 他因为生病没来上课。
en: He was absent from school on account of illness.

zh: 我没有想到我们会这样分手。
en: I never thought we'd end up like this.

zh: 他的生意失败了。
en: He failed in business.

zh: 来自岛上的居民向我们求助。
en: The islanders are asking us for help.

zh: 政府没有尽他们最大的努力去处理住房问题。
en: The government is not doing its best to solve the housing problem.

zh: 火车晚点了，所以我不能准时赶到那里。
en: The train was delayed, so I could not arrive there on time.

zh: 由于贫穷，他们不得不拼命工作。
en: Seeing as they're poor, they've no choice but to work their hardest.

zh: 没有你们，就没有这个组织。
en: This organization cannot exist without you.

zh: 如果情况有任何变化，请务必通知我。
en: Please inform me of any changes in the situation.

zh: 坦白地说，我不喜欢你的发型。
en: Frankly speaking, I don't like your haircut.

zh: 他非常诚实，所以我们可以依赖他。
en: He's very honest, so we can rely on him.

zh: 婴儿被志愿者们照顾着。
en: The babies are taken care of by volunteers.

zh: 橘子在温暖的地方生长。
en: Oranges grow in warm countries.

zh: 和他的弟弟相比，他不够聪明。
en: Compared to his brother, he's not so wise.

zh: 在长时间的缺席后，他终于来上学了。
en: He came to school after a long absence.

zh: 她说的极其快。
en: She spoke rapidly.

zh: 多亏了这场大雨，蔬菜价格直线上升。
en: Due to the heavy rain, vegetable prices have risen.

zh: 这一点儿也不好。
en: This is not good at all.

zh: 在暑假之后，我们马上就有一场考试。
en: We have exams right after summer vacation.

zh: 她劝告他不要那样做。
en: She advised him against doing it.

zh: 我们对女儿的健康问题很担忧。
en: We're anxious about our daughter's health.

zh: 我在医院住了一个星期。
en: I stayed in hospital for a week.

zh: 他对我们来说是完全陌生的。
en: He was an entire stranger to us.

zh: 他说地就像之前度过这本书一样。
en: He talks like he's already read the book.

zh: 我不能去那里，而且我根本不想去。
en: I can't go, nor do I want to.

zh: 她不仅没责怪他，反而称赞他。
en: It wasn't just that she didn't blame him - she actually praised the guy.

zh: 她更着急了。
en: She grew even more worried.

zh: 我怎么能忘记您交付我的任务？
en: How could I possibly forget about the task that you've entrusted to me?

zh: 如果下雨的话，我还是要去公园。
en: I'll still go to the park even if it rains.

zh: 她是文艺青年。
en: She is a young artist.

zh: 再惹我生气，小心我扒了你的皮！
en: Anger me again, I might just peel your skin off.

zh: 现在有剩余。
en: Now there is some left over.

zh: 它长得很茂盛。
en: It grew luxuriantly.

zh: 天气挺凉爽。
en: The weather is quite pleasantly cool.

zh: 谢谢你的修改。
en: Thank you for the corrections.

zh: 我是你的粉丝。
en: I am your fan.

zh: 你又皮发痒了，找抽，是吧？
en: You just can't stand still, huh? What are you, looking for a fight?

zh: 不知何时春暖花开， 今天早晨还下雪了。
en: I don't know when spring will come and when the flowers will bloom. It was still snowing this morning.

zh: 他比您更刻苦。
en: He's even more hardworking than you are.

zh: 她比您更刻苦。
en: She's even more hardworking than you are.

zh: 今天没有空做晚饭，所以我去买了盒饭。
en: I didn't have time to cook dinner tonight, so I went out and bought a box meal.

zh: 你后天有时间吗？
en: Are you free the day after tomorrow?

zh: 她一个接着一个不停地吃糖果，直到吃饱了为止。
en: She ate one sweet after another until she was completely full.

zh: 我们正好赶上最后一趟火车。
en: We just managed to catch the last train.

zh: 他每天工作八个小时。
en: He works eight hours every day.

zh: 他的身体很好。
en: He is in good health.

zh: 她一口气喝下半杯多凉茶。
en: She gulped down half her tea in one mouthful.

zh: 先肯定后否定，一正一反，就分外有力量。
en: First acknowledge, then deny – one for and one against – and then you are in a powerful position.

zh: 不管缺点怎么多，成绩还是最主要的。
en: No matter how many faults there are, our achievements are the main thing.

zh: 谁要是忽略这一点，谁就得犯错误。
en: Whoever ignores that point will make mistakes.

zh: 从无到有，这叫成就。
en: Going from not having to having – that’s success.

zh: 中国有中国的特点。
en: China has Chinese characteristics.

zh: 这些话，他听过不止一次，唯其不止一次，才忍无可忍。
en: He’d heard this more than once, but once was once more than he could bear.

zh: 要说，就要说得有力量，使对方失去反驳的能力。
en: If you're going to say it, you have to say it with force, and take away your opponent's ability to retaliate.

zh: 事情总比我们想的要复杂得多。
en: Things are always more complex than we think.

zh: 世界上没有两条完全相同的河流。
en: No two rivers in the world are completely the same.

zh: 总部里有另外一种气氛。
en: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.

zh: 对我们来说，最重要的是领会领导意图。
en: For us, what’s most important is understanding the intention of the leadership.

zh: 工人拿不到基本工资。
en: The workers didn't get their basic wage.

zh: 这倒是事实。
en: That’s actually the truth.

zh: 小偷一看到警车就跑走了。
en: The thief ran off as soon as he saw the police car.

zh: 那两个人一遇到彼此就开始吵架。
en: Those two people start arguing whenever they meet.

zh: 再没有比这更如意的办法了。
en: There couldn’t be a more ideal solution than that.

zh: 我的脑海里不停地翻腾着这个问题。
en: I constantly went over this problem in my mind.

zh: 想起这些，我忍不住要笑。
en: When I thought of that, I couldn’t help smiling.

zh: 我只要告诉他就好了，他肯定会干得到。
en: If I tell him, then it's as good as done. He'll definitely take care of it.

zh: 我想特别强调这一点。
en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.

zh: 这件事做起来没有听着这么难。
en: Once you do it, you see that it's not as hard as it sounds.

zh: 他试着哄他老婆开心，但他没做到。
en: He tried to cheer up his wife, but wasn't able to.

zh: 那么，我们从哪儿开始？
en: So, where shall we begin?

zh: 天空逐渐明亮了起来。
en: The sky is getting brighter.

zh: 开车差不多需要几个小时？
en: About how many hours does it take by car?

zh: 她很漂亮，聪明，并且最重要的是，她有一颗善良的心。
en: She's beautiful, smart, and - most importantly - has a good heart.

zh: 你那么看着我，我哪里放松得下来啊？
en: How can I feel relaxed, with you watching me like that?

zh: 手机如同马桶一样被细菌污染。
en: A cell phone is as contaminated with bacteria as a toilet is.

zh: 不许大叫。
en: Don't shout.

zh: 你到底做了什么？你不也是我的朋友吗？
en: Just what have you done? Aren't you also my friend?

zh: 我的儿子每次乘坐公交车都会晕车。
en: My son always gets sick when he rides a bus.

zh: 他冒着失去所有财产的危险。
en: He risked losing all his fortune.

zh: 我想知道那家饭馆有没有抓饭，所以进去看看。
en: Wondering if that restaurant had plov, I went inside.

zh: 我写了一篇文章，麻烦您看一下它行不行。
en: I've written an article. Could you take a look and tell me if it's okay?

zh: 我以为他是男的，原来她是女的。
en: I had thought that he was a man, but it turned out that he was a woman.

zh: 爸爸准许我去游泳。
en: My father allowed me to go swimming.

zh: 电脑可以做极为复杂的工作。
en: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.

zh: 我们觉得他一会儿就回来了。
en: We think he'll be back soon.

zh: 希望我们有机会再合作。
en: Hope we can do business again someday.

zh: 他在仅仅是在一旁旁观，而没有去阻止争吵。
en: He just looked on and didn't stop the quarrel.

zh: 他的援助真是雪中送炭。
en: His help has been invaluable.

zh: 可以在地图上展示给我看吗？
en: Can you show me on the map?

zh: 我住的城市靠近大海。
en: My town is by the sea.

zh: 不由得想起了故乡。
en: I can never forget my hometown.

zh: 事实上，她和这个丑闻没有任何关系。
en: In point of fact, she had nothing to do with the scandal.

zh: 学生们用心学习了很多首诗。
en: The students learned many poems by heart.

zh: 我害怕一个人处在黑暗之中。
en: I was scared to be alone in the dark.

zh: 对爱掩饰得越多，愈是证明你喜欢他。
en: The longer you hide your feelings for someone, the more you fall for them.

zh: 培养政治意识要花费时间。
en: Developing political awareness takes time.

zh: 我很疑惑为什么天气变冷的时候我会觉得很孤单。
en: I wonder why I feel so lonely when it gets cold.

zh: 所有的观众都站起来鼓掌。
en: The whole audience got up and started to applaud.

zh: 他让他的妻子补好衬衫。
en: He got his wife to mend his shirt.

zh: 她的父母不能不担心她的伤势。
en: Her parents can't help worrying about her injuries.

zh: 走路的时候，视线不要离开你的包。
en: Keep an eye on your bag while walking.

zh: 他充分利用了剩余的时间。
en: He made the best of the time left.

zh: 选手们的平均身高是多少？
en: What's the average height of the players?

zh: 我很怀疑他们的计划是否能够成功。
en: I have serious doubts about their plan succeeding.

zh: 在哪里可以买到车票？
en: Where can you get tickets?

zh: 你或许可以依靠他来帮助你。
en: You may depend on him to help you.

zh: 你也许要寻求他的帮助。
en: Perhaps you will seek his aid.

zh: 这场谈话真是无法再进行下去了。
en: There's really no way to continue this conversation any longer.

zh: 我们不能愁闷地看着这个城市就这样衰退下去。
en: We can't just look on dejectedly while this city continues to go into decline.

zh: 我浑身都被雨水给淋湿了。你现在能不能开车来接我？
en: I'm completely soaked from the rain. Can you drive over and pick me up right now?

zh: 啊！差点忘了。今天是扔垃圾的日子！
en: Oh, I almost forgot! Today is garbage disposal day!

zh: 他间隔了很久才作答。
en: There was a long interval before he replied.

zh: 如果明天天气好，那么我们就去野餐。
en: We'll go on a picnic if it's fine tomorrow.

zh: 我们会在第三章来解决这个问题。
en: We'll deal with this problem in Chapter 3.

zh: 如果你用功地读书你会考中的。
en: If you work hard, you'll pass your exam.

zh: 今年雪比去年下得多。
en: We had more snow this year than last.

zh: 这个药没有有害的副作用效果。
en: This medicine doesn't have any harmful side effects.

zh: 有时候我会想吃辣的东西。
en: Every now and then I like to have hot and spicy food.

zh: 科学发明并不总是使世界变得更美好。
en: Scientific discoveries don't always make the world a better place.

zh: 我会尽快给你打电话的。
en: I'll call you as soon as I can.

zh: 她大病初愈。
en: She recovered from her long illness.

zh: 她穿了一件宽松的长外套。
en: She wore a long, loose coat.

zh: 她花了好长时间挑帽子。
en: It took her a long time to choose a hat.

zh: 她不习惯长时间驾车。
en: She is not accustomed to driving for a long time.

zh: 她受得了长途旅行吗？
en: Can she endure a long trip?

zh: 她在大街上看见我的时候冲我笑了笑。
en: She smiled at me as she passed me in the street.

zh: 她非常想当口译。
en: She has a strong wish to work as an interpreter.

zh: 她有咬指甲的习惯。
en: She has a habit of biting her nails.

zh: 她在花园里种了桂花。
en: She planted fragrant olives in the garden.

zh: 她在花园里种了一些菜。
en: She seeded vegetables in her garden.

zh: 她给花园里的花都起了名字。
en: She named all the flowers in the garden.

zh: 她给花园除了草。
en: She weeded the garden.

zh: 谁来抓住他！
en: Someone! Catch that man!

zh: 我希望有人能教我英语作文。
en: I wish someone would help me with English composition.

zh: 他继承了他爸爸的庞大遗产。
en: He succeeded to his father's large property.

zh: 这就是我出生长大的房子。
en: This is the house in which I was born and brought up.

zh: 我在这里总感到约束。
en: I feel always restricted here.

zh: 他每个月挣50万日元。
en: He earns half a million yen a month.

zh: 我居然忘记了今天有课！
en: I completely forgot that there was class today!

zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.

zh: 如果你有上司的话，学会尊敬他（她）。
en: Be respectful to your superiors, if you have any.

zh: 周围太吵了，我无法专心学习。
en: It is too noisy around here; I can't concentrate.

zh: 她是个很坦率的人。
en: She has a very open personality.

zh: 形式是暂时的，等级才是永恒的。
en: Form is temporary, class is permanent.

zh: 催促客户去完成一件任务是很让人头疼的事。
en: Pushing customers to complete a task can be a headache.

zh: 已经错过了交货时间了，接来下该怎么办？
en: I have missed the delivery time, what should I do next?

zh: 关于该问题的答复，我两天后再回答你可以吗？
en: Regarding the question at hand, can I give you an answer in two days' time?

zh: 我们会根据您提出的要求对不足之处作出相应的改正。
en: We will follow your demands and make the necessary corrections to those parts that need them.

zh: 如果有什么更好的解决方案，我一定第一时间通知您。
en: If there's a better solution, then I'll notify you about it as soon as possible.

zh: 今天下午到我家来一趟。
en: Come to my house this afternoon.

zh: 与朋友吵架是件很伤感情的事。
en: Fighting with your friends can really hurt your feelings.

zh: 谢谢您在百忙之中抽出时间回复我的信件。
en: Thank you for taking some time out of your busy schedule to reply to my letter.

zh: 我们大家会一起努力地把这项任务按时完成的。
en: We will all work together to finish this task on time.

zh: 我想学标准的英语。
en: I want to learn standard English.

zh: 我一直这么认为并且坚持。
en: I've always believed in and insisted on this.

zh: 您应该让医生给您检查身体。
en: You should go get a physical examination from a doctor.

zh: 我看见他们胳膊挽着胳膊地走路。
en: I saw them walking arm in arm.

zh: 接下来该怎么做，我完全听从您的吩咐。
en: I will follow your advice fully from here onwards.

zh: 对不起，我们无法满足您的要求。
en: I am sorry, we are unable to satisfy your demand.

zh: 公司为了削减成本，拒绝让员工自行加班。
en: In order to cut down on costs, the company refuses to allow employees to work overtime.

zh: 对于我们来说，这已经是做出了最大限度的让步了。
en: In our view, we have already made the biggest possible compromise.

zh: 有个问题想请教您，可以吗？
en: I have a question I want you to answer. Can you?

zh: 他悄悄地递给我一张纸条。
en: He slipped me a note.

zh: 在我们公司每月都会举办社团活动。
en: Every month at our company, they run a community activity.

zh: 我有一点困惑了。
en: I'm a little confused.

zh: 她应该就那样一直保持沉默。
en: She should have kept her mouth shut.

zh: 报告者详尽地说明了他的研究方法。
en: The reporter elaborated on the method of his investigation.

zh: 这个城市很难打到出租车。
en: It's very hard getting a taxi in this city.

zh: 只有那样技术的国家，还想要做汽车，我们十分无法理解。
en: It is incomprehensible to us that a country with that level of technology would even think of making an automobile.

zh: 人们常说拿在手里没有感觉的东西还是放手的好。
en: People often say: "If something in your hand no longer feels right, it's better to let it go."

zh: 如何提高工作效率是我们现在要面临的难题。
en: The challenge we are going to face is how to increase work efficiency.

zh: 赞扬比批评更容易让人接受。
en: People can accept praise more easily than criticism.

zh: 多数人会犯相同的错误。
en: Many people make similar mistakes.

zh: 他们两个里高的那一个先出来了。
en: The taller of the two went out first.

zh: 他们俩中，高的那个先走了出来。
en: Of the two of them, the taller one went out first.

zh: 奶奶去世让全家都受了打击。
en: Grandmother's passing away came as a great blow to the entire family.

zh: 我们处理掉了他们家的老鼠。
en: We got rid of the mice in their house.

zh: 温度计指向十度。
en: The thermometer reads 10 degrees.

zh: 忍耐是最美的美德。
en: Patience is the most beautiful virtue.

zh: 水是生命的源泉。
en: Life cannot exist without water.

zh: 你是不是吸毒吸傻了？
en: Do you have a drug problem?

zh: 这附近有没有可以给手机充电的地方？
en: Is there a place where I can charge my cellphone around here?

zh: 我看上去像是很有力气的人，可实际上并非如此。
en: I may look strong, but I'm honestly not.

zh: 在旅游淡季，机票会很便宜。

zh: 说完这些话，他结束了会议。
en: With those words he brought the meeting to an end.

zh: 其他人正在离开呢，要不要等他们走完了我们聊聊？
en: The others are leaving. What do you say we wait for them to go away and talk for a while?

zh: 他遇到了一个优秀的年轻人。
en: He came across an outstanding young person.

zh: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。
en: The world is a book and each step opens a page.

zh: 我们要不在这里一下吧。我的脚好痛走不动了。
en: Let's just rest here for a little while, my feet are aching so much I can't walk.

zh: 谢谢您的迅速回复。
en: Thanks for your quick answer.

zh: 骄傲使人落后。
en: Pride goes before a fall.

zh: 我对这种愚蠢的行为表示非常的气愤。
en: I'm getting endlessly annoyed by this foolishness.

zh: 政府将采取强制措施来解决这一问题。
en: The government will adopt enforcement measures to solve this problem.

zh: 世界人口急剧增长。
en: World population has rapidly increased.

zh: 生活支出急剧上涨。
en: Living costs have increased rapidly.

zh: 非常时期需要非常措施。
en: Desperate times call for desperate measures.

zh: 请问;地铁在哪儿?
en: Excuse me. Where's the metro?

zh: 车票多少钱?
en: How much is a ticket?

zh: 你可以坐出租车。
en: You can take a taxi.

zh: 这儿有地铁站吗?
en: Is there a metro station here?

zh: 地铁站有点儿远
en: The metro station is quite far.

zh: 我们坐出租车吧
en: Let's get a cab.

zh: 她感到茫然。
en: She felt dazed.

zh: 不论黑暗多么辽阔，我们都必须提供自身的光明。
en: However vast the darkness, we must supply our own light.

zh: 阳光照亮田野，痛苦点亮心灵。
en: Sun lights the landscape, pain illuminates the soul.

zh: 我没有预定这个。
en: I didn't order this.

zh: 对于这份工作来说，我的年龄太老了。
en: I'm getting too old for this job.

zh: 我要一件新衬衫。你想要什么？
en: I want a new shirt. What do you want?

zh: 生产日期在盖子上。
en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.

zh: 我觉得吃完那块大牛排你就饱了。
en: I thought you'd be full after eating that big steak.

zh: 我曾经希望我妈妈能活到我结婚的时候。
en: I had hoped that my mother would live until I got married.

zh: 最好赶紧离开！
en: Better run away immediately!

zh: 风俗习惯包括食物，庆祝和舞蹈。
en: Customs include food, celebrations and dancing.

zh: 我在感受生命的气息。
en: I'm feeling the breath of life.

zh: 今天是个阴天。
en: Today is a cloudy day.

zh: 我觉得世界上的语言都很有意思。
en: I think that all the world's languages are very interesting.

zh: 他打扮得像女人一样。
en: He dressed up as a woman.

zh: 我从来没有见过谁像你这么虚伪的。
en: I've never known anyone as hypocritical as you.

zh: 过来和我跳舞啊!
en: Come and dance with me!

zh: 你觉得我明天约会穿什么好呢？
en: What do you think I should wear on my date tomorrow?

zh: 你令人难以抗拒。
en: You're irresistible.

zh: 在这个湖上滑冰安全吗？
en: Is it safe to skate on this lake?

zh: 5元硬币是黄铜做的，10元硬币是青铜做的。
en: The 5 yen coin is made from brass and the 10 yen coin is made from bronze.

zh: 他们是典型的年轻人。
en: They're typical youngsters.

zh: 这个画框能让画升值。
en: This picture frame can make the picture rise in value.

zh: 她要回国。
en: She's going to return to her country.

zh: 不要把精确和准确搞错。
en: Let's not mistake precision for accuracy.

zh: 我们算计着改革生产流程。
en: We are planning changes to the manufacturing process.

zh: 他提出改革研究方法的意见。
en: He's proposing a suggestion for altering the research method.

zh: 我没带眼镜就什么都看不到。
en: I can't see anything without my glasses.

zh: 我跟公司签了一份三年的合同。
en: This company and I have signed a three-year contract.

zh: 她用苹果来做果酱。
en: She used the apples to make the jam.

zh: 他看向四周，但没看到任何人。
en: He looked around, but he saw no one.

zh: 这个协会有三十个会员。
en: The association counts thirty members.

zh: 我申请成为协会会员。
en: I applied for membership in the association.

zh: 他能够超越所有困难。
en: He can overcome any obstacle.

zh: 我的收入减少了百分之十。
en: My income has decreased ten percent.

zh: 你不觉得这个名字很讽刺吗，「神圣的战争」？
en: Don't you think the name "The Sacred War" sounds a bit sarcastic?

zh: 我们喜欢踢足球。
en: We like to play soccer.

zh: 为什么你要试图隐藏自己的情感？
en: Why are you trying to hide your feelings?

zh: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。
en: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.

zh: 我不喜欢跟人打交道。
en: I don't like to socialize.

zh: 这是个旧部件。
en: This is an old unit.

zh: 我同他们没有过共同之处。
en: I had nothing in common with them.

zh: 要是你不在听广播的话，就关掉它。
en: If you're not listening to the radio, turn it off.

zh: 这种天气下最好待在家里不要外出。
en: It's best to stay in than to go out in that weather.

zh: 会不会只有我一个人去聚会？
en: Will I be the only one going to the party?

zh: 他执意不惜一切代价获得成功。
en: He is determined to succeed at any price.

zh: 即使是弯树也能遮阴。
en: Even crooked tree gives shade.

zh: 他不情愿地启动引擎开车走了。
en: Reluctantly, he started the engine and drove off.

zh: 她从事律师职业多年。
en: She practised as a barrister for many years.

zh: 这些天他们很少看电视。
en: They seldom watch television these days.

zh: 我们知道他是个勇敢的人。
en: We know him to be a brave man.

zh: 不要这么恶心。
en: Don't be so disgusting.

zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们就待在家里面。
en: We are staying at home because it's raining.

zh: 他消失了，不留一丝踪迹。
en: He vanished without a trace.

zh: 我的钥匙就是在这附近丢失的。
en: I lost my key about here.

zh: 他是个独立思考者。
en: He is an independent thinker.

zh: 我发誓我看到了外星人。
en: I swear, I saw an alien!

zh: 他被妻子诬陷了。
en: He was framed by his wife.

zh: 不言而喻。
en: That goes without saying.

zh: 我不是有意要保密的。
en: I didn't mean to keep it secret.

zh: 要是我坐了那架飞机的话，我现在早就死了。
en: If I had taken that plane, I would be dead now.

zh: 园丁后来发现就是凶手。
en: The gardener turned out to be the murderer.

zh: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。
en: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.

zh: 她会永远活在我们的记忆里面。
en: She will forever live on in our memories.

zh: 茶点过后我们接着开会。
en: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.

zh: 你太谦虚了。
en: You're too modest.

zh: 她忙着照料孩子。
en: She is busy with the care of her children.

zh: 自那以后他便过起了艰难的生活。
en: He led a hard life after that.

zh: 是警察，也许我们应该让道。
en: It's the police, perhaps we should get out of their way.

zh: 十岁时他就成了孤儿。
en: He became an orphan when he was ten.

zh: 我感觉有滴雨落在头上。
en: I felt a drop of rain on my head.

zh: 为什么我们在这上面浪费时间？
en: Why are we wasting time with this?

zh: 我没什么可隐藏。
en: I had nothing to hide.

zh: 她在他的背上戳了一下。
en: She stabbed him in the back.

zh: 被爱不一定是幸福，去爱才真的幸福。
en: Happiness is not to be loved, but to love.

zh: 我的父母是从中国来的。
en: My parents are from China.

zh: 怎么说：‘肺’？
en: How do you say "lung"?

zh: 同学们都在学英文。
en: The students are all learning English.

zh: 她的妈妈给她打电话。
en: Her mother calls her.

zh: 我们今天吃了很多饭。
en: Today we have a lot of food.

zh: 我不是故意吓唬你的。
en: I didn't mean to spook you.

zh: 你最喜欢哪一种酸奶？
en: What's your favourite yoghurt?

zh: 我有一支圆珠笔，可是我还想再要一支。
en: I have a ball-point pen, but I want another.

zh: 狮子，狼，大象，马，这些都是动物。
en: Lions, wolves, elephants, and horses are all animals.

zh: 她有一只狗和六只猫。
en: She has a dog and six cats.

zh: 这栋楼里面有中央暖气系统吗？
en: Is there central heating in this building?

zh: 我大学里的第一天相当没意思。
en: My first day in the university was rather boring.

zh: 她长得像她姑姑。
en: She resembles her aunt.

zh: 你定时间我就到那里。
en: Just name a time and I'll be there.

zh: 我觉得他们不会来了。
en: I don't think they're coming.

zh: 首相解散了国会。
en: The prime minister dissolved the Diet.

zh: 谈判没有成功。
en: The treaty was not a success.

zh: 请小心不要受伤了。
en: Please be careful not to get hurt.

zh: 自从我开始学汉语以来已经有两年了。
en: It's been two years since I started learning Chinese.

zh: 她给我打了一个看不懂的手势。
en: She gave me a hand gesture I didn't understand.

zh: 我才不管别人怎么想我。
en: I don't give a damn what people think about me.

zh: 没有人知道她在哪儿。
en: Nobody knows where she is.

zh: 他们全部都应该被开除。
en: They should all be fired.

zh: 你们那时候看起来在生气。
en: You guys looked mad.

zh: 我的驾驶教练说我应该更有耐心一点。
en: My driving instructor says I should be more patient.

zh: 我必须要换衣服，因为我现在穿的衣服不适合这个环境。
en: I had to change clothes because what I was wearing wasn't appropriate for the situation.

zh: 我不想承担这样一个风险。
en: I don't want to take such a risk.

zh: 这样说是不是更加地道呢？
en: Is it more idiomatic if I say it like this?

zh: 听说大数据技术现在很热门。
en: I hear that the network is very popular now.

zh: 独立的句子和文章中的句子的区别在于后者具备上下文。
en: The difference between a standalone sentence and a sentence in the middle of an essay is that the latter has context.

zh: 一个人得遇到多大的挫折才会自杀？
en: How frustrated must a person be to commit suicide?

zh: 这家报社在当地知名度颇高。
en: This newspaper is well known in the local area.

zh: 你怕虫子吗？
en: Are you afraid of bugs?

zh: 我刚跟你的法语老师谈过话，他说你在课堂上表现得很好。
en: I've just spoken to your French teacher and he says you're doing well in his class.

zh: 他们剧透了结局。
en: They gave away the ending.

zh: 你可以稍后回电给我吗?
en: Could you call me back a bit later?

zh: 谁是您最喜欢的导演？
en: Who is your favourite director?

zh: 我会给你一个苹果、
en: I'll give you an apple.

zh: 这位工程师正在法国工作。
en: The engineer is working in France.

zh: 那个四年计划必须获得批准。
en: That four-year plan has to be approved.

zh: 我吃掉了我所有的橘子。
en: I ate all my oranges.

zh: 你什么意思？你到底想对我说什么？
en: What do you mean? What do you want to tell me?

zh: 他反对垄断。
en: He was opposed to monopolies.

zh: 现在我开始发铜牌。
en: Now I am starting to issue copper medals.

zh: 这笔交易是我的，所以你需要去冷静并且同意我
en: This deal is mine, so you need to just settle down and agree with me.

zh: 这家商店有大量的极好的礼物
en: This store has lots of great gifts.

zh: 在人生中，你将会收获和失去，当时你不会强迫事情去发生
en: In life, you gain and lose things, but also can't force things to happen.

zh: 勇气是一个奇怪的东西：没有任何人对它有把握
en: Courage is a strange thing: One can never be sure of it.

zh: 当我死去的时候，谁将庆祝呢？
en: When I'm dead, who will be celebrating?

zh: 我的兄弟被捕了而不是他。
en: My brother was arrested, not him.

zh: 充满希望比绝望好。
en: To hope is better than to despair.

zh: 人类是唯一彼此交谈的动物。
en: Man is the only animal that talks.

zh: 人类是唯一能够彼此交谈的动物。
en: Man is the only animal that can talk.

zh: 不要和我开玩笑。我是很严肃的。
en: Don't make fun of me. I'm serious.

zh: 他不想要任何种类的花。
en: He wants no kind of flowers.

zh: 他瞄准了，却没命中。
en: He aimed, but missed.

zh: 它的感觉像是它把你吸到了另外一个世界。
en: It feels like it's going to absorb you into another world.

zh: 我们应该走出什么样的步伐。
en: What steps should we take?

zh: 我们应该往哪个方向走？
en: Which way should we go?

zh: 我非常享受你的陪伴。
en: I really enjoy your company.

zh: 为什么任何人应该感到惊喜？
en: Why should anyone be surprised?

zh: 我觉得我无法赞成这个建议。
en: I can't approve the proposal by myself.

zh: 你应该做一个外交官。
en: You should be a diplomat.

zh: 妈妈有一张残缺的脸。
en: Mama had a crippled face.

zh: 我对于上大学有一种渴望。
en: I feel a yearning for the university.

zh: 你有着漂亮的腿。
en: You have beautiful legs.

zh: 黑海里的水事实上是黑的吗？
en: Is the water in the Black Sea actually black?

zh: 你应该去竞选城市委员会。
en: You should run for city council.

zh: 第二优秀是远远不够的。
en: Second best is never enough.

zh: 勇气是非常重要的。比如肌肉，经常使用才得以加强。
en: Courage is very important. Like a muscle, it is strengthened by use.

zh: 他在一周前离开去往欧洲，就是说，是在五月十号。
en: He left for Europe a week ago, that is, on the tenth of May.

zh: 那些数字是什么？
en: What are those numbers?

zh: 这刚好是我想看到它发生的。
en: That's exactly what I wanted to see happen.

zh: 你收到了我发的邮件了吗？
en: Did you get my letter?

zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。
en: That's a huge challenge.

zh: 你可以给我一个提示吗？
en: Would you give me a hint?

zh: 我的车子的开销比你的要多。
en: My car cost more than yours did.

zh: 我知道失去一个人是什么感觉。
en: I know what it's like to lose someone.

zh: 你的名字已经从名单删除了。
en: Your name has been crossed off the list.

zh: 一些人批评了我们的决定。
en: Some people criticized our decision.

zh: 人们需要更多的交流。
en: People should get more involved.

zh: 这个椅子坐着真舒服。
en: This chair is really comfortable to sit on.

zh: 昨天他遇到了高大的男人。
en: Yesterday he saw a big man.

zh: 因为他们正在看电视。
en: Because they're watching television.

zh: 实际上你看到那个男人是女的。
en: The "man" that you saw is actually a woman.

zh: 人们通常不喜欢他们不理解的事物。
en: People usually don't like what they don't understand.

zh: 我妈妈小心翼翼地打开门。
en: My mother opened the door very carefully.

zh: 你真是没完没了
en: Don't you ever give up?

zh: 我仍旧无法相信我居然做了这种事。
en: I still can't believe I did it.

zh: “她也会来吗？” “我希望是这样。”
en: "Is she coming, too?" "I hope so."

zh: 他们签字了吗？
en: Did they sign?

zh: 如果这是真的，您要怎么办？
en: If that were true, what would you do?

zh: 我还有话要对您说。
en: I still need to talk to you.

zh: 外面在下雪呢。
en: It's snowing outside.

zh: 你的鞋脱哪儿了？
en: Where did you take your shoes off?

zh: 你是不是瞒着我什么？
en: Are you hiding something?

zh: 考试加油！
en: Good luck on your test.

zh: 还剩多少时间？
en: How much time is left?

zh: 这是要卖的东西吗？
en: Is this for sale?

zh: 你知道这是谁的字吗？
en: Do you know whose handwriting this is?

zh: 这张照片在哪儿照的？
en: Where was this picture taken?

zh: 上天会帮助自力更生的人。
en: Help yourself and God will help you.

zh: 我们打车去吧！
en: Let's catch a taxi!

zh: 明天九点打电话给我吧。
en: Call me at 9:00 tomorrow.

zh: 你头发上粘着什么东西。
en: There's something in your hair.

zh: 你觉着有外星人存在吗？
en: Do you think there are aliens?

zh: 再不快点你就要赶不上末班车了。
en: Hurry up, or you will miss the last train.

zh: 在你们远离家乡之前请给父母一个拥抱。
en: Give a hug to your parents before you get far away from your hometown.

zh: 您是在这儿用餐，还是给您打包带走？
en: Are you going to eat here or do you want us to wrap it?

zh: 他写得一手好字。
en: He writes Chinese characters very well.

zh: 我喜欢观察人们在听到我说出我是谁时的反应。
en: I love to watch people's reactions when I say who I am.

zh: 玩这些电脑游戏要反应灵敏。
en: You need to have quick reactions to play these computer games.

zh: 律师们会力劝家长们采取进一步的法律行动。
en: Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.

zh: 目前正在考虑是否由她来做这项工作。
en: She's being considered for the job.

zh: 我想花点时间斟酌斟酌再作决定。
en: I'd like some time to consider before I make a decision.

zh: 他对生活感到很无奈。
en: He feels powerless about his own life.

zh: 她把所有的业余时间都用在钓鱼上了。
en: She devoted all her spare time to fishing.

zh: 灯光太暗了，我没法阅读。
en: The light is too dim for me to read easily.

zh: 我无奈只得跟随着她。
en: I was compelled to follow her.

zh: 他觉得必须报道这件事。
en: He felt compelled to report the incident.

zh: 我们必须把它彻底检查一下。
en: We have to thoroughly investigate it.

zh: 你要看一部法国片，是吗？
en: You want to watch a French film, is that right?

zh: 你可以用望远镜看星星。
en: You can use a telescope to look at the stars.

zh: 我们还应该看下这个房子的内部。
en: We should look inside this house as well.

zh: “我必须检查下伤口，”医生说道。
en: "I need to inspect the wound," said the doctor.

zh: 我把他看作我的朋友。
en: I consider him my friend.

zh: 最好的减肥方法就是少吃多运动。
en: The best way to lose weight is to eat less and exercise more.

zh: 我唱得好听。
en: I sing well.

zh: 当飞机穿越强风时，它们会像这样摇晃，但是别担心。
en: Passing through the strong wind, the planes rock like this, but don't worry.

zh: 我是游客。
en: I am a tourist.

zh: 她举止优雅。
en: She is graceful.

zh: 如果某天你发现你一无所长你会怎么办？
en: If one day you realised that you are good for nothing, what will you do?

zh: 解决失业最好的办法是去工作
en: The best way to solve unemployment is to work.

zh: 我老是忘记人们的名字。
en: I always forget people's names.

zh: 别缠我了!
en: Stop bugging me!

zh: 我感觉大家都在关注我。
en: I feel like everybody's watching me.

zh: 这样对待他似乎不太公平。
en: It doesn't seem very fair to treat him like this.

zh: 我鄙视你。
en: I despise you.

zh: 有多少人在那里工作？
en: How many people work there?

zh: 就连最黑暗的夜晚都会结束，太阳仍会照常升起。
en: Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.

zh: 他们把房子装饰了一下。
en: They decorated the room.

zh: 限制白糖和盐的摄取量。
en: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.

zh: 我今天、明天还是后天清理我的房间有什么不同吗？
en: Is there any difference whether I clean my room today, tomorrow, or the day after tomorrow?
