zh: 你今天晚上去电影院吗？
en: Will you go to the cinema tonight?

zh: 在他身上没有大城市人的那种冷漠。
en: He doesn't have the indifference typical of people from big cities.

zh: 呼吸点新鲜空气会让我好些。
en: A little fresh air will do me good.

zh: 愚昧始终是危险的。
en: Ignorance is always dangerous.

zh: 这个例子举得不好。
en: It's a bad example.

zh: 在这个房间里我很舒服。
en: I'm quite comfortable in this room.

zh: 比起出去钓鱼，我更想待在家里。
en: I'd rather stay home than go fishing.

zh: 我越了解人，我就越喜欢动物。
en: The more I know about people, the more I like animals.

zh: 上个月我在话费上花了很多钱。
en: Last month I spent a fortune on the telephone bill.

zh: 我英文水平中等。
en: My level in English is intermediate.

zh: 不好意思，请问鸡蛋在哪儿？
en: Excuse me. Where are the eggs?

zh: 各位想喝果汁还是水？
en: Would you all like to drink fruit juice or water?

zh: 那个位置很偏僻。
en: It's quite a remote spot.

zh: 我的兄弟喜欢集邮。
en: My brother likes to collect stamps.

zh: 我的信用卡无效。
en: My credit card was invalid.

zh: 这个坏掉的花瓶无法修复了。
en: This broken vase can't be repaired.

zh: 我想学日语，但是我不喜欢看日本动画片。
en: I want to learn Japanese but I don't like watching anime.

zh: 这是一个狗咬狗的无情世界。
en: It's a dog-eat-dog world.

zh: 是挺好看的，但我不喜欢红色。
en: Yes, it's pretty, but I don't like red.

zh: 您越是多吃巧克力，您就会变得越胖。
en: The more chocolate you eat, the fatter you'll get.

zh: 我去火车站买车票。
en: I went to the train station to buy a ticket.

zh: 请你站在我后面。
en: Please stand behind me.

zh: 你可以在书店买到各种类型的报纸。
en: You can buy all kinds of newspapers at the bookstore.

zh: 大家都很喜欢这个节日。
en: Everyone likes this festival very much.

zh: 服务员，请给我们菜单。
en: Waiter, please give us the menu.

zh: 她告诉我明天有一个重要的会议。
en: She told me that there is an important meeting tomorrow.

zh: 请你介绍一下你的家人。
en: Please introduce your family.

zh: 我可以介绍你认识我的朋友。
en: I can introduce you to my friends.

zh: 课开始了，请大家坐好。
en: The class has started. Please take your seats.

zh: 我正在准备明天的数学考试。
en: I am preparing for tomorrow's math exam.

zh: 考试结束后，我们可以放松一下了。
en: After the exam, we can relax.

zh: 我每天早上七点起床。
en: I wake up at 7 o'clock every morning.

zh: 他是经理吗？
en: Is he the manager?

zh: 我对你失去信心
en: I've lost faith in you.

zh: 昨天晚上气温突然下降
en: There was a sudden drop in the temperature last night.

zh: 在街上乱丢垃圾不是好习惯，记得吗？
en: Throwing garbage on the street is not a good habit, remember?

zh: 跟我说你上个暑假做了什么。
en: Tell me what you did last summer vacation.

zh: 那别墅因为听说闹鬼所以很便宜。
en: The mansion was so cheap because it was known to be haunted.

zh: 我儿子现在数数能数到一百了。
en: My son can count up to a hundred now.

zh: 我觉得我们团队会继续变好。
en: I think our team is going to continue to get better.

zh: 如果被他知道我们在这里，他会杀了我们。
en: If he knows that we're here he'll kill us.

zh: 他从路上捡起一样白色的东西。
en: He picked up something white on the street.

zh: 我完全没料到会在这里碰到你。
en: I didn't expect to see you here at all.

zh: 看看四周，你会看到很多人在做一样的事情。
en: If you look around, you'll see many people doing the same thing.

zh: 他跟我们说他不能吃花生。
en: He told us he couldn't eat peanuts.

zh: 他说他不想坐在她旁边。
en: He said that he didn't want to sit next to her.

zh: 那台电脑中毒了。
en: The computer has a virus.

zh: 他们认为当时是采取行动的最好时机。
en: They decided it was a perfect time to make the move.

zh: 那个男人的尸体至今仍未被找到。
en: That man's body still hasn't been found.

zh: 让我们祈祷他学得很快吧。
en: Let's pray he turns out to be a fast learner.

zh: 我能尝点你的面包吗？
en: Can I try your bread?

zh: 蛋是圆的不是方的。
en: Eggs are round, not square.

zh: 我们上幼儿园。
en: We go to kindergarten.

zh: 他有群众魅力。
en: He has charisma.

zh: 你具体需要些什么？
en: What exactly do you need?

zh: 她是强大的对手，不是吗？
en: She's a tough competitor, isn't she?

zh: 为什么你在爬这棵树？
en: Why are you climbing this tree?

zh: 在村庄里，我们还是用木头给房子取暖。
en: In the village we still heat our homes with wood.

zh: 我们来打开窗子吧。
en: Let's open the window.

zh: 这是你在网上找到的吗？
en: Did you find that on the internet?

zh: 换我是你，我会在银行里存放那些钱。
en: If I were you, I'd put the money in a bank.

zh: 我在电视上看到过她。
en: I saw her on TV.

zh: 因为我懂你而且你不是那样子。
en: Because I know you and you aren't like that.

zh: 只是在屏幕上闪了一下。
en: It's just a blip on a screen.

zh: 我经常梦见她。
en: I dream about her a lot.

zh: 你认得它吗？
en: Do you recognise it?

zh: 你是一名杰出的摄影师。
en: You're a brilliant photographer.

zh: 我眼睛里进沙子了。
en: I got some sand in my eye.

zh: 你那样做是合理的。
en: It's reasonable that you should do that.

zh: 你的刀生锈了。
en: Your knife is rusty.

zh: 第二个吧。
en: I'd say the second one.

zh: 情况很棘手。
en: The situation is difficult.

zh: 她尽了自己的职责。
en: She performed her duties.

zh: 你在不在市区？
en: Are you in the city or not?

zh: 我们须做该做的事。
en: We need to do what's necessary.

zh: 科学家们尚未找到对这神秘现象的解释。
en: The scientists have not found any explanation for the mysterious phenomenon.

zh: 我动不了。
en: I can't move.

zh: 没有人比我更渴望这个了。
en: No one wants this more than I do.

zh: 她即使不化妆也非常可爱。
en: Even without makeup, she's very cute.

zh: 我知道超出我们的预算了，但是我就想买下来。
en: I knew it was out of our price range, but I wanted to buy it anyway.

zh: 这个网站很实用。
en: This website is very useful.

zh: 我后天以前必须要完成这个工作。
en: I must finish this work by the day after tomorrow.

zh: 这个词有多少个音节？
en: How many syllables are in this word?

zh: 图片在镜子中出现了。
en: Images appeared in the mirror.

zh: 你还记得我们还在小学时你和我一起去动物园那次吗？
en: Do you remember the time you and I went to the zoo together when you and I were in elementary school?

zh: 现在我规律服药。
en: Now I take medication regularly.

zh: 我还有好多问题要问你呢。
en: I still have so many questions to ask you.

zh: 他们告诉我他们会说两种语言。
en: They told me they were bilingual.

zh: 你干什么给她钱呢？
en: Why did you give her money?

zh: 我开心得不得了。
en: I was over the moon!

zh: 他肯定是南方人。
en: He must be from the South.

zh: 我叫服务员。
en: I'm calling the waiter.

zh: 很难描述。
en: It's really difficult to describe.

zh: 快步前进，同志们！
en: Hurry on, comrades!

zh: 我的眼睛疼。
en: My eye hurts.

zh: 我找不到我的袜子！
en: I couldn't find my socks!

zh: 火车里太多人了，所以我走路算了。
en: The train was crowded, so I resorted to walking.

zh: 战争是绝对的邪恶。
en: War is an absolute evil.

zh: 你很聪明，你应该明白这个。
en: You are smart. You must understand that.

zh: 我需要你的眼睛。我不能阅读这个。
en: I need your eyes. I can't read that.

zh: 「他是特意的。」「谁特意在做什么？」
en: "She's doing it on purpose." "Who's doing what on purpose?"

zh: 小心，这个设备很贵的。
en: Be careful. That's an expensive piece of equipment.

zh: 这些水闻起来很香。
en: This water smells good.

zh: 现在别看这里。
en: Don't look here now.

zh: 他酒驾被逮着了。
en: He was caught drink-driving.

zh: 去阳台上晒晒太阳怎么样？
en: Why don't you go out on the balcony and get some sun?

zh: 我一点都不喜欢这个城市。
en: I don't like this city at all.

zh: 您确定那本书在这个书架上？
en: Are you sure the book is on this shelf?

zh: 没有儿童的房子就如同没有鲜花的花园一般。
en: A house without kids is like a garden without flowers.

zh: 人的行为不总是理性的。
en: People don't always behave rationally.

zh: 她在门上刷上了红色的漆。
en: She painted the door red.

zh: 红色和黄色和蓝色是颜色。
en: Red, yellow and blue are colors.

zh: 你有证据证明那真的发生了吗？
en: Do you have any proof that that happened?

zh: 好漂亮的婚纱！
en: What a beautiful wedding dress!

zh: 我他妈的才不管你们说什么！
en: I don't give a fuck about what you say!

zh: 我家小的不喜欢去看牙。
en: My child dislikes the dentist.

zh: 咱一块儿来唱首歌。
en: Sing a song with me.

zh: 书里讲的是一条不会喷火的龙的故事。
en: The book tells the story of a dragon that can't breathe fire.

zh: 我好久好久没听到这个笑话了。
en: I haven't heard that joke in ages.

zh: 所有教师都在场。
en: All the teachers were there.

zh: 总得有过河的办法。
en: There must be some way of traversing the river.

zh: 我很生气我被骗了。
en: I was angry that I had been fooled.

zh: 牌没洗开。
en: The deck was poorly shuffled.

zh: 软件就像性交一样，免费的更好。
en: Software is like sex: it's better when it's free.

zh: 有两人说他们听到了一声枪响。
en: Two people say they heard a gunshot.

zh: 我本来打算搭这辆公共汽车，但是很拥挤。
en: I was going to take this bus, but it's very full.

zh: 我年轻，而且——既然你是我邻居——你也知道我的性情。
en: I am young; and, as I have been your neighbour, you know my character.

zh: 她披上一件外套，上了路。
en: She threw on a coat and set off.

zh: 她在离市中心不远处租了间公寓。
en: She rented an apartment close to downtown.

zh: 「你能带我去商店吗？」「你的自行车呢？」「被人偷走了。」
en: "Can you take me to the store?" "What about your bicycle?" "It was stolen."

zh: 每一堵墙都是一扇门。
en: Every wall is a door.

zh: 她们俩同时爱上了同一个男人。
en: They both fell in love with the same man.

zh: 事情是怎么到这个境地的？
en: How did things get this far?

zh: 能解释为愚蠢的，就不要解释为恶意。
en: Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by stupidity.

zh: 可以请你小声一点吗？
en: Could you speak a little less loudly?

zh: 昨天一点风也没有。
en: There was no wind at all yesterday.

zh: 用尺子画线。
en: Draw a line with a ruler.

zh: 这个引用出自哪里？
en: Where does this quote come from?

zh: 我在这张地图上的哪里？
en: Where am I on this map?

zh: 他为了孩子的幸福，拼命的工作。
en: He worked hard to make his child happy.

zh: 我在便利店买了肉包吃了。
en: I bought meat buns at the convenience store and ate them.

zh: 不好意思，可以帮我拿下砂糖吗？
en: Excuse me, would you mind passing me the sugar?

zh: 正好那个时候，公交车停下来了。
en: Just then, the bus stopped.

zh: 请把我送到家门口。
en: Drop me off at the front door, please.

zh: 南方和北方的差异很大。
en: The north differs greatly from the south.

zh: 最近我的体重减少了。
en: I've lost weight recently.

zh: 无人准翻译此句。
en: No one is allowed to translate this sentence.

zh: 尊重你的父母，网钱是他们付的。
en: Respect your parents. They pay for the internet.

zh: 狗停下了脚步，好像在抗议。
en: The dog stopped walking, as if to complain.

zh: 跟随你的心灵，不要跟随你的恐惧。
en: Follow your heart, not your fears.

zh: 只有没目睹那场战争的人才喜欢它。
en: The war is liked by only those who haven't seen it.

zh: 弹钢琴需要手指灵活。
en: Playing the piano requires manual dexterity.

zh: 人上课时安静意味着他尊重他人的睡眠。
en: To be quiet in class is to respect other people's sleep.

zh: 她住海边，可还是不会游泳。
en: She lives by the sea, yet she still can't swim.

zh: 危险尚在。
en: The danger has not passed yet.

zh: 您有哪些弱点呢？
en: What are your weaknesses?

zh: 别咳嗽了，都要听不见电视了。
en: Stop coughing. I can't hear the TV.

zh: 把我当晚餐吃了吧！
en: Eat me for dinner.

zh: 她没能说服他为她写首歌。
en: She couldn't convince him to write a song for her.

zh: 不怎么见效。
en: It's not very effective.

zh: 所有宗教都想要和平，要战争的都是别人。
en: All religions want peace, it's the others who want war.

zh: 那儿的水深到我碰不到底。
en: The water there was so deep that I could not touch bottom.

zh: 爬树的动物, 比如猫, 长有爪子。
en: Animals that climb trees, like cats, have claws.

zh: 某些动物烦躁不安, 可能是地震临震前的预兆。
en: Agitated activity by certain animals may be a sign of an impending earthquake.

zh: 票不到一个钟头就卖得精光。
en: All the tickets sold out in an hour.

zh: 这张钞票是假造的。
en: This is a forged banknote.

zh: 你喝茶搁糖吗？
en: Do you take sugar in your tea?

zh: 差不多一半同学都学过英语。
en: Nearly half the students have learned English.

zh: 铁路连通了两个城市。
en: A railroad has connected the two cities.

zh: 这里正在筹划建设一座发电站。
en: Plans are being drawn up to build a power station here.

zh: 他的羽毛球打得真厉害。
en: He plays badminton very well.

zh: 国际局势发生了很大的变动。
en: There have been great changes in the international situation.

zh: 一开头她吓坏了, 后来才定下神来。
en: At first she was terrified, then she pulled herself together.

zh: 文章开头讲了当前的形势。
en: The article begins with an account of the current situation.

zh: 我不在乎是否听起来自然，别人能理解就好。
en: I don't care about sounding natural. I just want to be understood.

zh: 在正确使用的情况下，枪可以救人性命。
en: Guns can be life-savers when used properly.

zh: 他认为只有训练有素的演员才能够获得成功。
en: He thinks that only very well trained actors can be really successful.

zh: 麻烦在我离开的时候帮忙照顾我的狗。
en: Please take care of my dog while I'm away.

zh: 你从哪儿买的这些蛋？
en: Where did you buy these eggs?

zh: 你听见有人按门铃了吗？
en: Did you hear someone ring the doorbell?

zh: 他在抚摸那只狗。
en: He was petting the dog.

zh: 你有看过镜子里的自己吗？
en: Have you seen yourself in the mirror?

zh: 他善于在青年中识拔人才。
en: He is good at spotting young talent.

zh: 大妈, 我们给您拜年来啦！
en: Auntie, we’ve come to wish you a Happy New Year.

zh: 我听到了一个很有意思的谣言。
en: I heard a very interesting rumor.

zh: 我第一任妻子去世了。
en: My first wife is dead.

zh: 这真的不让你感兴趣吗？
en: Does that really not interest you?

zh: 发泄很少改善我的情绪，反而经常使它更糟。
en: Venting rarely improves my mood and often makes it worse.

zh: “你期待这次会议吗？” “它没什么值得期待的。”
en: "Are you looking forward to the conference?" "There's nothing to look forward to about it."

zh: 打扫屋子真的是我最害怕的工作。
en: Cleaning up the house is truly my most dreaded task.

zh: 一点新鲜空气对身体有好处。
en: A little fresh air does the body good.

zh: 展望未来！
en: Look towards the future!

zh: 欧洲是一个比我以为的还要危险的地方。
en: Europe is more dangerous than I thought.

zh: 下雨了。我们找地方躲一下吧。
en: It's raining. Let's take shelter.

zh: 我可以用这部电话拨打外线电话吗？
en: Can I make an outside call on this phone?

zh: 你为什么想学习那门语言？
en: Why do you want to learn that language?

zh: 7月份工业生产大幅增长。
en: Industrial production rose sharply in July.

zh: 有谁想一起去吃饭吗？
en: Anybody wanna grab something to eat with me?

zh: 我把钱都花在衣服、食物和书籍上了。
en: I spent my money on clothes, food and books.

zh: 尽管雨猛地开始下大了，我们还是决定继续野餐。
en: Although the rain started falling heavily, we decided to continue our picnic.

zh: 你现在还爱你的妻子吗？
en: Do you still love your wife?

zh: 我不饿。我刚吃过早餐。
en: I'm not hungry. I just had breakfast.

zh: 冰箱里什么也没有了。
en: There's nothing left in the fridge.

zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是棕色。
en: My favorite color is brown.

zh: 过去，我父亲常常喝酒直到深夜。
en: My father used to drink till late at night.

zh: 我到家后给你打电话。
en: I'll give you a call when I get home.

zh: 他在教学上拥有丰富的经验。
en: He has long experience in teaching.

zh: 今天我们住酒店吧。
en: Let's stay at a hotel tonight.

zh: 你的论文写完了吗？
en: Have you finished writing your thesis?

zh: 他宣布与她订婚。
en: He announced his engagement to her.

zh: 大道之行也，天下为公。
en: When the great way is followed, the world is for the common good.

zh: 没人知道等待我们的是什么。
en: No one knew what awaited us.

zh: 我坐在火车上总还是比掉到火车底下要好。
en: It's better for me to sit on the train than to be crushed.

zh: 这趟火车有卧铺车吗？
en: Does this train have a sleeping car?

zh: 我干这一行已经很久了。
en: I've been in this business a long time.

zh: 我们的销量今年翻了一番。
en: Our sales doubled this year.

zh: 远处传来歌声。
en: Songs can be heard in the distance.

zh: 能加你微信吗？
en: Can I have your number?

zh: 禁止越过白线。
en: Crossing the white line is forbidden.

zh: 你是个好人，只不过长得好像很坏。
en: You are a good person, but you look like a bad person.

zh: 不要扭曲我说的话。
en: Don't twist my words.

zh: 「怎么没跟我们说呢？」「你们又没问。」
en: "Why didn't you tell us?" "You didn't ask."

zh: 省略掉无用的词！
en: Omit needless words!

zh: 空气是无形的。
en: Air is invisible.

zh: 你会不会泡巧克力牛奶？
en: Do you know how to make chocolate milk?

zh: 关于这一点没什么可说的。
en: Nothing much to say about that.

zh: 1955年她的癌症复发，她1956年去世，享年42岁。
en: In 1955, the cancer returned and she died in 1956 at the age of 42.

zh: 您是在暗示我太年轻了吗？
en: Are you implying that I'm too young?

zh: 咳嗽的时候会痛吗？
en: Does it hurt when you cough?

zh: 我对博物馆感到厌烦，博物馆是艺术的坟场。
en: I'm tired of museums, - graveyards of the arts.

zh: 把灯关了好不好，蚊子要来了。
en: Turn off the light, please. The mosquitoes are coming.

zh: 我上了大巴。
en: I got on the bus.

zh: 我登上了大巴车。
en: I got onboard the bus.

zh: 专家就好像一台只有一根弦的小提琴一样。
en: Specialists are people who have only one string on their violin.

zh: “我不能抓我的主人。”猫说。
en: "I cannot claw my owner", said the cat.

zh: 她揉了揉她的眼睛。
en: She rubbed her eyes.
